--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 약제사 윈링 (shuran) 전용 무기 기술
--region state
local local_class = newclass('CwpShuranBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
    local obj = {}
    obj.state = state or nil
    obj.local_class = parent_class
    setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
    return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
    local prev_state = self.state

    if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
        prev_state:exit(new_state)
    end

    self.state = new_state

    if self.state then
        if self.state.current_time_passed then
            self.state.current_time_passed = 0
        end

        if self.state.enter then
            self.state:enter(prev_state)
        end
    end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
    if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
        return
    end

    local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
    self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

    if self.state.update then
        self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
    end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
    return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
    --- enter state
    enter = nil,
    --- exit state
    exit = nil,
    --- update state
    update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
    local obj = {}
    setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
    return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
    --- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
    machine = nil,
    --- 상위 클래스
    action = nil,
    --- 오너
    owner = nil,
    --- CS 클래스
    cs_action = nil,

    --- 탐색 범위
    search_range = nil,
    --- 액션 길이
    action_duration = nil,

    --- 현재 지나간 시간
    current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
    local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
    obj.action = parent_class
    obj.owner = parent_class.owner
    obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
    obj:init(param, level)

    return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
    --- 탐색 범위
    self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
    --- 액션 길이
    self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

    --- 투사체 사출 오프셋
    self.shoot_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootOffset')
    --- cs projectile shooter
    self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
    --- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
    self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

    --- 투사체 발사 타이밍
    self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
    self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')

    --- 적중 가능한 거리
    self.hittable_dist = self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

    --- 대시 타이밍
    self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
    --- 대시 속도
    self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
    --- 대시 지속시간
    self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
    return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
    return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
    return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
    --- attackrange 기준으로 대상과 적중이 가능한지 판단한다.
    local target_dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
    return target_dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
    --- 강제 캔슬 플래그 리셋
    self.force_cancel = false
    self.trigger_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
    --- 목표
    self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
    --- 목표 방향
    self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
    --- 배틀액션 활성화
    self.cs_action.IsActive = true

    battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
    battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
    --- 스크린 이펙트 생성
    battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)

    local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset

    self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, nil, nil, nil)

    --- 보이스 출력
    battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
    --- camera darken
    battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5, 0.1)
    --- 사운드 재생
    battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
    --- 배틀액션 비활성화
    self.cs_action.IsActive = false

    character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))

    --- remove animation
    battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
    --- remove locked dir
    battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
    --- 뒤로 흔드는 연출을 해지
    --character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

    if self.current_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
        battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
    end

    effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
    self.cast_fx = nil
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
    --- 발사 전 까지 방향 갱신
    if old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
        self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

        self.shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset

        effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, self.shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)
    end

    --- 패왕염탄 발사 시점
    if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
        local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset

        effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)

        --- 카메라 쉐이크
        battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.1)
        --- 사운드 재생
        battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'fire')

        local shoot_position = self.trigger_pos + self.dir_vector * self.offset
        --- shoot projectile
        shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
            self.shoot_helper[1],
            shoot_position,
            self.dir_vector
        )
        self.height = battle_util.get_height(shoot_position)

        -- 발사 반동이 아니라 자기가 쏘는거라서 균형잡아야 하는 느낌이라 반동이 발생하면 안될 것 같은 느낌.
        --character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.4, 0.0, self.dash_duration)

        local dynamic_dash_duration = battle_util.get_dash_duration_until_wall(self.owner, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, -self.dir_vector)
        --- 발사 반동에 의한 넉백
        battle_util.melee_short_dash(
            self.cs_action, nil, -self.dir_vector,
            0, dynamic_dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
            nil, nil, 0
        )
    end

        --- 액션이 끝난 상황
    if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
        --- state reset
        self.machine:change(nil)

        --- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
        message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
    end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
    --- 자연 소멸이거나 충돌로 인한 소멸일 경우
    if hit_info.hit_type == projectile_hit_type.force_eliminate then return true end

    --- 싱크 정보 생성
    local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

    --- 위치 싱크
    trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, hit_info.position)

    --- 싱크 정보 배포
    command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
    return true
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
    --- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
    machine = nil,
    --- 상위 클래스
    action = nil,
    --- 오너
    owner = nil,
    --- CS 클래스
    cs_action = nil,

    --- damage type
    damage_type = nil,
    --- atk modifier
    atk_modifier = nil,
    --- 데미지 배율
    main_damage_scale = nil,
    sub_damage_scale = nil,

    --- 상태이상 정보
    ailment_info = nil,

    --- 판정 계산기
    calculator = nil,
    --- 판정 타이밍
    hit_timing = nil,
    --- 판정 횟수
    max_hit = nil,

    --- 현재 지나간 시간
    current_time_passed = 0,
    --- 대상 위치
    target_pos = nil,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
    local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
    obj.action = parent_class
    obj.owner = parent_class.owner
    obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
    obj:init(param, level)

    return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
    --- damage type
    self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
    --- atk modifier
    local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
    local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
    self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
    --- 상태 이상 정보
    self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

    --- 반지름
    local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
    --- 높이
    local height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Height')
    --- 판정 정보
    local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
        radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true
    )
    --- 판정 계산기
    self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

    --- 판정 타이밍
    self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
    --- 판정 횟수
    self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

    --- 첫타 메인 계수
    self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
    --- 서브 계수
    self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (#self.hit_timing - 1)
end

--- 판정이 필요한 시점에 trigger 정보 갱신. 대상의 위치로부터 판정을 처리한다.
function field_state_class:sync(info)
    local hit_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
    --- 대상 위치를 지면으로 정렬
    self.target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info))
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
    --- 충돌체 계산은 시작시 한번만 세팅. 업데이트중 세팅할 필요 없음.
    area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

    --- 화염 기둥 연출
    battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
    battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
    battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.2)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
    --- 판정 처리
    for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
        if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
            local is_first_hit = idx == 1
            local is_last_hit = idx == self.max_hit

            --- 데미지 배율 획득
            local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

            --- 범위 충돌 계산 시작
            area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

            --- 범위내 대상들에게 피해를 적용한다.
            for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
                self:apply_damage(target, modifier, is_first_hit and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale)
            end

            --- 범위 충돌 계산 종료
            area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

            --- 막타 판정
            if not is_last_hit then
                battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.28, 0.2)
            else
                battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.35)
                self.machine:change(nil)
            end
        end
    end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
    --- 데미지 정보 생성
    local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
    damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
    damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
    damage_info.sender = self.owner
    damage_info.target = target
    damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
    damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
    damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

    damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

    --- 데미지 커맨드 발행
    command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
    self.cs_action = cs_action
    self.owner = c
    self.level = level

    --- parsing each info
    self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

    --- 액션 스테이트
    self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
    --- 액션 스테이트용 머신 추가
    self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
    --- 스테이트 머신 지정
    self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

    --- 판정 상태
    self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
    --- 판정 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
    self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
    --- 판정 스테이트 머신 지정
    self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
    --region state 해지
    do
        self.state_machine:change(nil)
        self.state_machine = nil

        battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

        self.action_state = nil
    end
    --endregion

    --region json 기반 정보들 해지
    do
        battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

        self.animation_info = nil
        self.emotion_info = nil
        self.preset_info = nil
        self.sfx_info = nil
    end
    --endregion

    --- 해제
    self.cs_action = nil
    self.owner = nil
    self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
    return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
    --- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
    return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
    --- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
    return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
    return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
    return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
    self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
    --- 트리거 정보 구성
    local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

    --- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
    local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

    --- 대상이 존재할 경우
    if target then
        trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
    end

    --- append direction
    trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

    --- 트리거 커맨드 발행
    command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

    return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
    self.action_state:start(info)
    self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
    if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
        return
    end

    --- state reset
    self.state_machine:change(nil)

    --- publish cancel event
    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
    --- 강제 캔슬 플래그 체크
    if self.action_state.force_cancel then return end

    self.field_state:sync(info)
    self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
    --- 강제 캔슬 플래그 지정
    self.action_state.force_cancel = true
    battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.2)

    --- 판정 스테이트 초기화
    self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- short dash
	battle_util.melee_short_dash(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
		0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
		CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, false, 0
	)

	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'dash')
		--- special 보이스 출력
		battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, character_voice_type.special_2)
	else
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'dashfallback')
		--- 보이스 출력
		battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'screen')

	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 삭제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- 만료 전에 해제 되었다면 즉시 해제해야한다.
	local canceled = self.current_time_passed > self.hit_timing[1] and self.current_time_passed < self.remain_timing
	if canceled then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_explosion, true)
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'end',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		)
	else
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_explosion, false)
	end
	self.fx_explosion = nil
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.cast_timing) then

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'cast',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			nil,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.explosion_timing) then
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
		battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
		local trigger_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner))

		self.fx_explosion = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'explosion',
			trigger_pos

		)
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

		--- 시전할 위치 동기화
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, trigger_pos)
		--- 커맨드 발행
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.remain_timing) then
		--- 필드 트리거 커맨드
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 커맨드 발행
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	end

	--- 판정 순회
	for index = 1, self.max_hit do
		repeat
			--- 판정 시점
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
				--- 데미지 계수
				local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)
				local is_first = index == 1
				local is_last = index == self.max_hit
				--- 데미지 / 상태 이상 스케일
				local scale = is_first and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale

				if is_first then
					battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.45, 0.14)
				elseif is_last then
					battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.15)
				else
					battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.1)
				end
				--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
				area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
				--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
				area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

				--- 충돌체 계산기 대상 순회
				for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
					--- 판정 적용
					self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
				end

				--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
				area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
			end
		until true
	end

	--- 실제 액션 만료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_explosion)
		self.fx_explosion = nil
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end

	if self.fx_explosion then
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_explosion, battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner)))
	end
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_position(info) then
		self.field_state:sync(info)
	else
		self.field_state_machine:change(self.field_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
	if self.field_state_machine then
		self.field_state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 콜라보 리무르 (slime_rimuru) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpSlimeRimuruBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 데미지 스케일
	damage_scale = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 암전 종료 타이밍
	undarken_timing = nil,

	--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 무기 옵션 버프
	cwp_buff_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
		--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	--- 짧은 변
	local short_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShortBase')
	--- 긴 변
	local long_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LongBase')
	--- 길이
	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')

	--- 사다리꼴 백터
	local points = {
		0, short_base * 0.5,
		length, long_base * 0.5,
		length, -long_base * 0.5,
		0, -short_base * 0.5
	}

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_polygon_cube(points, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 데미지 스케일
	self.damage_scale = 1 / self.max_hit

	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	--- 암전 종료 타이밍
	self.undarken_timing = math.max(self.action_duration - 0.2, 0)

	self:apply_option(param)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 무기 옵션 id
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')
	--- 옵션 적용 여부 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션 적용 시
	if activate_option then
		--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 무기옵션 버프 정보
		self.cwp_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'CwpBuff')
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locekd direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, self.activate_cwp_option and 'cast' or 'castfallback')
	--- set emotion
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- instantiate effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		'cast',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner),
		nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	--- play sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- instantiate screen effect
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)


	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- 무기옵션이 적용된 경우
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		--- 스페셜 대사 재생
		battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, character_voice_type.special_1)
		--- 무기옵션 버프 부여
		self:apply_ally_buff()

	--- 무기옵션이 적용되지 않은 경우
	else
		--- 기본 보이스 출력
		battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	end
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.tornado_fx then
		--- 마지막 판정 이전에 해제되는 것이라면 바로 해제되게 한다.
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.tornado_fx, true)
		self.tornado_fx = nil

		--- end 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'end', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector)
	end

	if self.tornado_sfx then
		--- 효과음 fade 처리
		sfx_util.fade_out(self.tornado_sfx, 0.1)
		self.tornado_sfx = nil
		--- 종료 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'end', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	end

	--- 암전 해제 전에 이탈한 경우 기본암전 처리
	if self.current_time_passed < self.undarken_timing then
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	---remove emotion
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 첫 판정 전까진 대상이 유효한 경우는 방향을 돌림
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.hit_timing[1] then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 중심
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	--- aim_point 갱신
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)

	--- 이펙트가 유효한 경우 위치 방향을 갱신한다.
	if self.tornado_fx then
		effect_util.update_object(self.tornado_fx, center, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 효과음이 유효한 경우 위치를 갱신한다.
	if self.tornado_sfx then
		sfx_util.set_position(self.tornado_sfx, center)
	end

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍이 아닐 경우 생략
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		if idx == 1 then
			--- 첫 타의 경우 연출 처리 추가
			self.tornado_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'attack', center, self.dir_vector)
			--- 효과음 출력
			self.tornado_sfx = battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'attack', center)

			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.18)
		elseif idx == self.max_hit then
			--- 마지막 타격일 경우 이펙트를 해제함
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.tornado_fx)
			self.tornado_fx = nil
			--- 효과음이 fade out 되지 않도록 레퍼런스를 날림
			self.tornado_sfx = nil
			--- 종료 효과음 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'end', center)

			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.3)
		else
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.18)
		end

		--- 판정 처리
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, center, self.dir_vector)
		--- 하나라도 판정되지 않았다면 생략
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 액션 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)
		--- 데미지 부여
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, self.damage_scale)
		end

	until true end

	--- 암전 종료
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.undarken_timing) then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.6)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info.knock_back_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(target, self.owner)
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 효과음 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function action_state_class:apply_ally_buff()
	--- 스테이지 멤버
	local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)

	--- 파티원 순회
	for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
		--- 사망 여부 체크
		if character_util.is_dead(member) then break end

		--- 버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, member, self.cwp_buff_info)

		--- 소환된 소환수 순회
		for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
			--- 버프 적용
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, summonable, self.cwp_buff_info)
		end

	until true end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 슈나 (slime_shuna) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpSlimeShunaBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,

	--- 무기기술 충돌체 정보 캐싱 변수
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 무기기술 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- 폭발 판정 최소 크기
	explosion_min_radius = 0,
	--- 폭발 판정 최대 크기
	explosion_max_radius = 0,

	--- 메인 데미지 계수
	main_damage_scale = 0,
	--- 서브 데미지 계수
	sub_damage_scale = 0,

	--- 장판 시작 타이밍
	cast_timing = 0,

	--- 전용무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 무기기술 히트 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	--- 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing
	--- 마지막 판정 타이밍
	self.last_hit_timing = self.hit_timing[self.max_hit]

	--- 반지름 증가하기 시작하는 타이밍
	self.expand_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExpandTiming')

	--- 폭발 판정 최소 크기
	self.explosion_min_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionMinRadius')

	--- 폭발 판정 최대 크기
	self.explosion_max_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionMaxRadius')

	--- 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 원형 실린더 판정
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.explosion_min_radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

	--- 첫타 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (#self.hit_timing - 1)

	--- 장판 시작 타이밍
	self.cast_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CastTiming')
	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상과의 거리 계산
	local target_dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- 최소 반지름 기준으로 체크.
	return target_dist <= self.explosion_min_radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- 무기기술 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		--- cast anim
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
		--- special 보이스 출력
		battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, character_voice_type.special_1)
	else
		--- cast anim
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'castfallback')
		--- 보이스 출력
		battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 사운드 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.4)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.cast_timing) then
		--- 캐스팅 타이밍 이후 장판 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'fire', character_util.get_position(self.owner))
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.expand_timing) then
		--- 판정범위 커질 때 출력 애니메이션, 전용무기 아닌 경우에만 출력
		if false == self.is_exclusive_weapon then
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'expandfallback')
		end
	end

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍이 아니라면 생략
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 최초 판정인지 체크
		local is_first_hit = idx == 1

		--- 타이밍 일때마다 카메라 쉐이크
		if true == is_first_hit then
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.13)
		else
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.13)
		end

		local expand_rate = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((self.hit_timing[idx] - self.expand_timing) / (self.action_duration - self.expand_timing))

		--- 체크 전 변경된 반지름 반영
		self.collision_info.Radius = (self.explosion_max_radius - self.explosion_min_radius) * expand_rate + self.explosion_min_radius

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, character_util.get_position(self.owner))

		--- 피격 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 액션 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 데미지 부여
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			local damage_scale = is_first_hit and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale
			self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, damage_scale)
		end

	until true end

	--- 화면 암전 종료 처리
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.9) then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	--- 넉백 추가
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 상태이상 수치 추가
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 피격시 sfx 정보 생성
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 히트 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(target))

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	do

--- 스나이퍼 헤카테 (sniper) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpSniperBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 판정 시점
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 판정 정보
	local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info)

	--- hittable distance (일단 search_range 기반으로 처리한다)
	self.hittable_dist = self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return distance <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- set aim point
	spine_util.set_aim_point(
		self.owner, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	)

	--- instantiate cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- instantiate screen effect
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
	--- instantiate ready effect
	self.ready_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'ready', self.target_pos)

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	--- camera shake
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, self.hit_timing)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.ready_fx)
	self.ready_fx = nil
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 판정 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- instantiate explosion effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
		--- play explosion sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.35)

		--- 위치 설정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 판정 처리
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)
		if #fo_list > 0 then
			--- 데미지 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			for _, t in pairs(fo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
			end
		end

		--- 판정 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- 스턴 적용
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 상태이상 적용
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 목표 위치
	local target_pos = target and
		character_util.get_position(target) or
		battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner) + dir_vector * self.action_state.search_range)

	--- append position
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, target_pos)
	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 영혼술사 도화 (soulpower_girl) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpSoulpowerGirlBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 무기기술 히트 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	--- 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	--- 판정 반지름
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 원형 실린더 판정
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- attack 애니메이션 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)

	--- 첫타 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (self.max_hit - 1)
end

	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)

	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		--- cast anim
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	else
		--- cast fallback anim
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast_fallback')
	end

	--- 대상 위치 미리 캐싱
	self.target_pos = self.target
		and character_util.get_position(self.target)
		or battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.search_range)

	--- cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	--- circle effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'circle', self.target_pos)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- instantiate screen fx
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- dir vector 를 바라보게 설정
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)

	--- attack 애니메이션 재생 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		if not self.is_exclusive_weapon then
			--- attack fallback anim
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack_fallback')
		end
	end

	--- sfx 재생 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[1]) then
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')
	end

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍이 아니라면 생략
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

		--- 피격 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 액션 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 첫 타 일땐 메인 데미지 스케일
		local damage_scale = idx == 1 and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale

		--- camera shake
		if idx == 1 then
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.12)
		else
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.12)
		end

		--- 데미지 부여
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, damage_scale)
		end

	until true end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	--- 넉백 추가
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 상태이상 수치 추가
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
