--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 슈타르크 (stark) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpStarkBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
		--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	self.main_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	self.sub_scale = 1 - self.main_scale

	--- 공격 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 판정 범위
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 속도
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 지속시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	---  슬레시 에니메이션 연출 시작
	self.slash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SlashTiming')

	---  스메쉬(2차 점프 공격) 에니메이션 연출 시작
	self.smash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SmashTiming')

	--- 점프 타이밍
	self.jump_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'JumpTiming')

	--- 점프 시간
	self.jump_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'JumpDuration')

	--- 점프 채공 시간
	self.jump_aerial_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'JumpAerialDuration')

	--- 대시 거리
	self.dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	--- 판정체 목록
	self.calculator = {}

	---순차적으로 재생할 이펙트
	self.fx_name = {}
	table.insert(self.fx_name, 'slash')
	table.insert(self.fx_name, 'explosion')

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		self.hit_timing[idx] = self.hit_timing[idx]
		--- 판정 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius[idx], height, nil, nil, nil)
		--- 판정 계산기 생성
		table.insert(self.calculator, area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, 1))
	end

	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)

	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = self.dash_dist + self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	if self.target then
		self.target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.target)
		self.target_pos = vector(self.target_pos.x,bounds_util.get_center(self.owner).y, self.target_pos.z)
	else
		self.target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * (self.search_range + 2)
	end
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성 및 재생
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen_cast')

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, character_voice_type.special_1)
	end

end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.dash_fx)

	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)

	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'dash')
		--- 대시 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil, nil, 0
		)

		--- 대시 이펙트
		self.dash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action,
			'dash',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing + self.dash_duration) then
		--- 이펙트 제거
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.dash_fx)
		self.dash_fx = nil
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.slash_timing) then
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'slash')
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'slash')

	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.smash_timing) then
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'smash')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_timing) then
		character_util.jump(self.owner, 3, self.jump_duration, self.jump_aerial_duration, false)
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'jump', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	end

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			local target_pos = idx == 1 and bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) or self.target_pos

			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, self.fx_name[idx], target_pos, self.dir_vector)

			--- 스크린 이펙트 생성 및 재생
			battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen_fire')

			local hit_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator[idx], target_pos, self.dir_vector)

			if idx == 1 then
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
			else
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.35)
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'smash')
			end

			--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 반환함
			if #hit_targets == 0 then
				return
			end

			local scale = idx == 1 and self.sub_scale or self.main_scale

			--- 각각 적중한 대상들에게 피해 적용
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, scale)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
		self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier
	) * scale

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_mute_sfx_info()

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 용기사 샤피라(steam_knight) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpSteamKnightBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 공격 타이밍
	attack_timing = nil,
	--- 공격 오프셋
	offset = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 공격 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
	--- 공격 오프셋
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- instantiate cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.3)

	--- play default voice
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.current_time_passed < self.action_duration then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)
	end

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있는 경우
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.attack_timing then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- attack timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 싱크 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.owner.Position + self.offset * self.dir_vector)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region area state

local area_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- aliment info
	aliment_info = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 범위
	radius = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 판정 시작 위치
	position = nil,
	--- 판정 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 영향을 준 대상
	hit_targets = {}
}
area_state_class.mt = { __index = area_state_class }

--- create area state
function area_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function area_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 범위
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (#self.hit_timing - 1)
end

--- info sync
function area_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 판정 시작 위치
	self.position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 판정 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- area state enter
function area_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')

	--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.position)

	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.42)
end

--- area state exit
function area_state_class:exit(_)
	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.7)

	--- 영향을 준 타겟 리셋
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
	end
end

--- area state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function area_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do repeat
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 범위 내의 ifo
			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(self.position, self.radius)

			--- loop ifo
			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
				if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
					break
				end

				local scale = self.hit_targets[target] == nil and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale

				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)

				self.hit_targets[target] = true
			until true end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			--- reset state
			if index == #self.hit_timing then
				self.action.area_machine:change(nil)
			end
		end
	until true end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function area_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 기본 사운드 mute
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

---endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- area state
	self.area_state = area_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- area state machine
	self.area_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.area_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.area_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.area_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.area_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부

	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)

--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부

	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- @return boolean 제어 여부

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부

	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- create aliment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- get search range
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 데미지 및 힐 범위
	self.damage_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageRadius')
	self.damage_height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageHeight')
	local damage_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageDuration')
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageTerm')
	local max_num_hit = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MaxNumHit')

	--- 강제 캔슬 여부
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	--- 싱크되는 타겟
	self.locked_target = nil

	--- 싱크되는 방향
	self.locked_dir = nil

	--- 내부 스테이트 정의
	self.state = {
		--- 아무 것도 안하는 상태
		none = {
			enter = function(prev_state) end,
			exit = function(next_state) end,
			update = function(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt) end
		},
		--- 액션 상태
		action = {
			enter = self.enter_action_state,
			exit = self.exit_action_state,
			update = self.update_action_state
		}
	}

	--- 현재 스테이트
	self.current_state = self.state.none

	self.current_time_passed = 0

	--- 프로젝타일 생성 정보
	self.proj_info = {
		speed = 0,
		accel = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ProjectileAccel'),
		accel_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ProjectileAccelDuration'),
		duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ProjectileDuration'),
		wait_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'WaitDuration'),
		proj_fx = nil,
		angel_fx = nil -- 가브리엘에게서만 보일 천사 이펙트
	}

	--- 싱크 되서 업데이트가 되어야하는 함수
	self.proj_func = nil

	--- 가브리엘 전용 무기인지 체크
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.character)

	--- 옵션이 적용되었는지 여부
	self.activate_option = false

	--- 가브리엘 전용 무기 옵션 체크
	self:apply_option(self.cs_action, params)

	--- 개화 옵션 적용
	self:apply_myth_option(params, level)

	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.damage_radius, self.damage_height, damage_duration,
		damage_term)

	self.collision_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, collision_info, false, 0, max_num_hit)
end

function local_class:apply_myth_option(params, level)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'MythOptionId')
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.character)

	--- 옵션 활성화 여부 확인
	if not has_myth_option then
		return
	end

	self.active_myth_option = true

	--- 6성 판정범위
	self.damage_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'DamageRadius')
end

--- 현재 스테이트를 바꿔준다
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.current_state = new_state

	self.current_time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.current_state == self.state.none
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.current_state == self.state.action
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.current_state == self.state.action
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, target) <= self.search_range * 0.8
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	--- 타겟 지정 및 방향 설정
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.character, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	self.locked_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	self.locked_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self:change_state(self.state.action)

	-- 이전에 생성된 프로젝타일이 있으면 실행을 중지한다.
	if self.proj_func then
		self.proj_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- proj func 이 실행 되고 있을때는 해당 효과들을 직접 해지하지 않는다
	if self.proj_func == nil then
		--- fx 및 애니메이션 제거
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_info.proj_fx, true)
		self.proj_info.proj_fx = nil

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_info.angel_fx, true)
		self.proj_info.angel_fx = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		local sync_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)

		self.proj_func = self:create_proj(self.proj_info, dir_vector, sync_pos)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true

	--- fx 제거
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_info.proj_fx, true)
	self.proj_info.proj_fx = nil

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_info.angel_fx, true)
	self.proj_info.angel_fx = nil

	self.proj_func = nil
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_force_canceled then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.current_time_passed

	--- 스테이트 업데이트
	func_util.call_if(self.current_state.update, self.cs_action.IsActive, self, old_time_passed,
		self.current_time_passed, dt)

	--- 싱크한 프로젝타일 업데이트
	if self.proj_func ~= nil then
		self.proj_func(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.proj_info = nil
	self.proj_func = nil

	self.collision_calculator = nil

	self.locked_target = nil
	self.locked_dir = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	--- Json 기반 변수들 해제
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)
	self.animation_info = nil
	self.emotion_info = nil
	self.preset_info = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	--- 변수 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
end

function local_class:enter_action_state()
	--- FX & 애니메이션 재생
	local fx_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.character.Position)
	self.proj_info.proj_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'proj', fx_pos)

	--- 가브리엘이 사용할 때만 나오는 이펙트
	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		self.proj_info.angel_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'angel', fx_pos)
	end

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', self.character.Position)
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self, self.character)

	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.locked_dir))

	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.65, 0.2)

	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	battle_util.default_shake_and_play_voice(self.cs_action)
end

function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, _, dt)
	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + dt

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, self.current_time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 프로젝타일 생성 싱크 작업
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

		local dir_vector = nil

		--- 타겟이 있으면 타겟을 향해서, 없을 경우에는 처음 고정된 방향으로
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, self.locked_target) then
			dir_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(self.locked_target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		else
			dir_vector = self.locked_dir
		end

		--- 발사할 방향 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, dir_vector)
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.character.Position))

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, sync_info)

		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function local_class:exit_action_state()
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- 프로젝타일 생성 및 업데이트
function local_class:create_proj(proj_info, dir_vector, sync_pos)
	local proj_old_time_passed = 0
	local proj_time_passed = 0
	local wait_duration = proj_info.wait_duration
	local speed = proj_info.speed
	local accel = proj_info.accel
	local accel_duration = proj_info.accel_duration
	local duration = proj_info.duration
	local proj_pos = sync_pos

	--- 네트워크가 밀릴 경우 Cancel이 사이에 끼어들어 기존 이펙트의 싱크가 깨질 수 있음
	--- 밸런스팀 내 논의 하에 이럴 경우 이미 네트워크 싱크가 밀린 상황이므로 새 이펙트를 생성하도록 함
	if self.proj_info.proj_fx == nil then
		self.proj_info.proj_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'proj', sync_pos)
	end

	--- 충돌체가 실행되고 있었으면 종료
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.collision_calculator) then
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.collision_calculator)
	end

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.collision_calculator, proj_pos)
	area_collision_util.start(self.collision_calculator)

	--- 실제 업데이트 하는 부분
	return function(dt)
		proj_old_time_passed = proj_time_passed
		proj_time_passed = proj_time_passed + dt

		--- 가속도 처리
		if wait_duration < proj_time_passed and proj_time_passed < wait_duration + accel_duration then
			speed = speed + accel * dt
		end

		--- 프로젝타일 위치 업데이트
		proj_pos = proj_pos + dir_vector * speed * dt

		effect_util.update_object(self.proj_info.proj_fx, proj_pos)

		if self.is_exclusive_weapon and self.proj_info.angel_fx ~= nil then
			effect_util.update_object(self.proj_info.angel_fx, proj_pos)
		end

		--- 충돌 계산기 활성화되면 데미지 및 힐 계산 실행
		if area_collision_util.is_started(self.collision_calculator) and
			not area_collision_util.is_finished(self.collision_calculator) then

			--- 충돌체 위치 계산
			local collision_pos = vector(proj_pos.x, proj_pos.y + self.damage_height * 0.5, proj_pos.z)

			area_collision_util.set_position(self.collision_calculator, collision_pos)

			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.collision_calculator, dt)

			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				--- 적이면 공격
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
					local dps = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action,
						self.attack_modifier, area_collision_util.get_max_hit(self.collision_calculator))
					self:apply_damage(target, dps)

					--- 아군 + 전용 무기 옵션 활성화되었을 때
				elseif self.activate_option and battle_util.can_apply_heal(self.character, target, false) then
					--- 캐릭터 회복력
					local heal_stat = character_util.get_recovery(self.character)

					local heal_amount = heal_stat * self.option_heal_multiplier / area_collision_util.get_max_hit(self.collision_calculator)
					self:apply_heal(target, heal_amount)
				end
			end

			ifo_list:Dispose()
		end

		--- 다시 밝아지는 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(proj_old_time_passed, proj_time_passed, 2.5) then
			battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
		end

		--- 모든 시퀀스가 끝났을 때
		if proj_time_passed > duration then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.collision_calculator)

			-- 이펙트 해제
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_info.proj_fx)
			self.proj_info.proj_fx = nil

			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_info.angel_fx)
			self.proj_info.angel_fx = nil

			-- 프로젝타일 함수 할당된 부분 해제해줌
			self.proj_func = nil
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 처리
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1 / area_collision_util.get_max_hit(self.collision_calculator))

	--- 히트 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(target))

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.08, 0.2)
end

--- 실제 힐 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_heal(target, heal_amount)
	--- 배틀 매니저와 파티가 없다면 리턴
	if battle_manager == nil or party_manager:GetPartyFor(self.character) == nil then
		return
	end

	local battle = battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.character)

	--- 전투 중이 아니라면 힐하지 않음
	if battle == nil then
		return
	end

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.character
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(heal_amount)

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

--- 가브리엘 전용 무기 옵션 적용
function local_class:apply_option(cs_action, params)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.character)

	if activate_option then
		self.activate_option = true

		--- 옵션 적용할 힐 계수
		self.option_heal_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'CwpHealMultiplier')
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 스트리머 루리 (streamer_girl) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpStreamerGirlBattleAction')

--region state
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 첫 타 타이밍
	attack_timing = nil,
	--- 공격 가능한 거리
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')

	--- 공격 적중할 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 적중 가능한 거리
	self.hittable_dist = self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- attackrange 기준으로 대상과 적중이 가능한지 판단한다.
	local target_dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	return target_dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 리셋
	self.force_cancel = false
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 캐스팅 애니메이션은 좌우만 있음으로 방향을 치환 후 적용한다.
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dir_vector))

	--- 전무 여부 따른 애니 분기 처리
	local anim_key = self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast' or 'fallback'
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, anim_key)

	--- 스크린
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 캐스팅 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 살짝 점프
	character_util.jump(self.owner, 1, 0.35, 0.07)

	--- 시전 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- 시전 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- 카메라 암전
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	--- 쉐이크
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.15)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	if self.current_time_passed < self.attack_timing then
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end

	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 공격 이전 시점
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.attack_timing then
		--- 타겟, 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 판정이 필요한 시점이 되었다. (첫타)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 시전자 위치
		local owner_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
		local target_pos = nil

		--- 타겟이 유효한 경우
		if self.target then
			--- 시전자의 위치 획득
			target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
		else
			--- 타겟이 유효하지 않을 땐, 공격 위치는 바라보는 방향으로 시전
			target_pos = owner_pos + self.search_range * self.dir_vector
		end

		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 목표 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, target_pos)
		--- 싱크 커맨드 발행
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 액션 시간 만료. 배틀액션이 종료되었음을 알린다.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 액션 스테이트를 종료시켜준다.
		self.machine:change(nil)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,

	--- 메인 계수
	damage_scale = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상 위치
	target_pos = nil,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 판정 오프셋
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	--- 메인 계수
	self.damage_scale = 1 / self.max_hit

	--- 생성 시점
	local create_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')

	--- 생성 시점 기준으로 히트 판정 재계산
	for idx = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		self.hit_timing[idx] = self.hit_timing[idx] - create_time
	end
end

--- 판정이 필요한 시점에 trigger 정보 갱신. 대상의 위치로부터 판정을 처리한다.
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 판정 위치 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos))
	--- 포토샷 장판
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'field', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos))
	--- 암전 해제 연출을 길게 뺀다.
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 1.2)
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'field')
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 판정 처리
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		--- hit 판정 테이블 - 첫타시간 만큼 빼서 체크를 한다. (fieldState 시작이 첫타시간만큼 늦게 시작되기 때문)
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			local is_first_hit = idx == 1
			local is_last_hit = idx == self.max_hit

			--- 데미지 배율
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 범위 충돌 계산 시작
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- 범위내 대상들에게 피해를 적용한다.
			for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, self.damage_scale)
			end

			--- 범위 충돌 계산 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

			--- 중간 타격
			if not is_last_hit then
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.18, 0.1)
			else
				--- 막타
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.25)
				self.machine:change(nil)
			end
		end
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(character, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = character
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- 액션 스테이트
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- 액션 스테이트용 머신 추가
	self.action_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.action_machine

	--- 판정 상태
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- 판정 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 판정 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.action_machine:change(nil)
		self.action_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	do
		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.field_state)

		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.action_machine and self.action_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_closest_target_simple(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.action_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.action_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 체크
	if self.action_state.force_cancel then
		return
	end

	--- 판정 정보 동기화
	self.field_state:sync(info)
	--- 판정 머신 동작
	self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 지정
	self.action_state.force_cancel = true

	--- 판정 스테이트 초기화
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 내부 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.action_machine then self.action_machine:update(dt) end
	--- 판정 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 서큐버스 영애 비앙카(succubus_noble) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpSuccubusNobleBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- state name
	name = nil,
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 캔슬 가능 타이밍
	cancelable_timing = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

function action_state_class:new(parent_class, action_duration, cancelable_timing)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj.action_duration = action_duration
	obj.cancelable_timing = cancelable_timing
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:set(dir_vector)
	self.dir_vector = dir_vector
end

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set cast Animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- shake and play voice
	battle_util.default_shake_and_play_voice(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.current_state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 캔슬 가능한 시점인가?
function action_state_class:is_cancelable()
	return self.cancelable_timing <= self.current_time_passed
end

--endregion


--region explosion state

local explosion_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 최대 타격 가능 횟수
	max_hits = nil,
	--- 겹침 데미지 처리의 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 겹침 데미지 처리의 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 시전 범위
	cast_radius = nil,
	--- 폭발 공격 시작 타이밍
	attack_timing = nil,
	--- 최대 폭발 개수
	limit_explosion = nil,
	--- 폭발 범위
	radius = nil,
	--- 플레이어로부터 폭발 위치까지 오프셋
	offset = nil,
	--- 폭발 사이의 간격
	distance = nil,
	--- 폭발 지속 시간
	duration = nil,
	--- 폭발 사이의 텀
	term = nil,
	--- 데미지 텀
	damage_term = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 현재 위치
	current_pos = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 진행 중인 폭발 위치
	explosion_position = {},
	--- 이번 페이즈에 영향을 준 대상
	hit_targets = {},
	--- 이번 페이즈에 영향을 준 대상
	scale_targets = {}
}
explosion_state_class.mt = { __index = explosion_state_class }

function explosion_state_class:new(
	parent_class, max_hits, main_damage_scale, cast_radius, attack_timing,
	limit_explosion, radius, offset, distance, duration, term, damage_term
)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj.max_hits = max_hits
	obj.main_damage_scale = main_damage_scale
	obj.sub_damage_scale = (1 - main_damage_scale) / (max_hits - 1)
	obj.cast_radius = cast_radius
	obj.attack_timing = attack_timing
	obj.limit_explosion = limit_explosion
	obj.radius = radius
	obj.offset = offset
	obj.distance = distance
	obj.duration = duration
	obj.term = term
	obj.damage_term = damage_term
	return obj
end

function explosion_state_class:set(dir_vector)
	self.dir_vector = dir_vector
	self.current_pos = self.owner.Position + self.offset * self.dir_vector
end

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function explosion_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 시전 Fx 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', self.owner.Position)

	--- 시전 Sfx 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.6)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
		self.owner.Position, self.cast_radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			self.scale_targets[target] = 2 ^ self.max_hits
			self.action:apply_damage(target, self.sub_damage_scale)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function explosion_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 폭발 정보 리셋
	for index = #self.explosion_position, 1, -1 do
		self.explosion_position[index] = nil
	end

	--- 피해를 준 대상 정보 리셋
	for target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[target] = nil
		self.scale_targets[target] = nil
	end

	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function explosion_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	for index = 1, self.limit_explosion do
		--- 폭발 시작 시점
		local explosion_timing = self.attack_timing + (index - 1) * self.term
		--- 폭발 종료 시점
		local end_timing = explosion_timing + self.duration

		if old_time_passed < end_timing and explosion_timing <= time_passed then
			--- 폭발 시점
			if old_time_passed < explosion_timing then
				--- 바닥 위치를 찾아줌
				local ground_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.current_pos)

				--- 폭발 Fx 생성
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', ground_pos, self.dir_vector)

				--- 첫번째 폭발일 경우에 사운드 재생
				if index == 1 then
					--- 폭발 Sfx 재생
					battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')
				end

				--- shake camera
				stage_camera:Shake(0.08, 0.3)

				--- 진행중인 폭발 위치 테이블에 넣어줌
				table.insert(self.explosion_position, ground_pos)

				--- 다음 폭발 위치 계산
				self.current_pos = self.current_pos + self.distance * self.dir_vector

				if index == self.limit_explosion then
					battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)
				end
			end

			self:on_explosion(index, time_passed)

			if index == self.limit_explosion and end_timing <= time_passed then
				self.action.explosion_state_machine:change(nil)
			end
		end
	end
end

function explosion_state_class:on_explosion(index, timing)
	--- 비트 연산을 위해 인덱스를 바꿔줌
	local binary_index = 2 ^ index
	local max_binary_result = 2 ^ (self.max_hits + 1) - 2
	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
		self.explosion_position[index], self.radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		repeat
			--- 적대 플래그가 아닌 경우
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) == false then
				break
			end

			self.hit_targets[target] = self.hit_targets[target] or {}
			self.scale_targets[target] = self.scale_targets[target] or 0

			--- 이미 해당 인덱스의 폭발에서 영향을 준 경우
			if self.hit_targets[target][index] ~= nil and
				self.hit_targets[target][index] + self.damage_term > timing then
				break
			end

			--- 비트 연산을 하기 위한 데이터 가공
			self.hit_targets[target][index] = timing

			--- 최대 타격 횟수를 초과했을 경우
			if self.scale_targets[target] >= max_binary_result then
				break
			end

			for power = 1, self.max_hits do
				local power_result = 2 ^ power

				if self.scale_targets[target] & power_result == 0 then
					self.scale_targets[target] = self.scale_targets[target] + power_result

					local scale = power == 1 and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale

					self.action:apply_damage(target, scale)

					break
				end
			end
		until(false)
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- create aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	local action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 캔슬 가능 타이밍
	local cancelable_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CancelableTiming')

	--- 최대 타격 가능 횟수
	local max_hits = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'MaxHits')
	--- 겹침 데미지 처리의 메인 계수
	local main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MainDamageScale')

	--- 시전 범위
	local cast_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CastRadius')
	--- 폭발 공격 시작 타이밍
	local attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackTiming')
	--- 최대 폭발 횟수
	local limit_explosion = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'Limit')
	--- 폭발 범위
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')
	--- 플레이어로부터 폭발 위치까지 오프셋
	local offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Offset')
	--- 폭발 사이의 간격
	local distance = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Distance')
	--- 폭발 길이
	local duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ExplosionDuration')
	--- 딜레이 텀
	local term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DelayTerm')
	--- 데미지 텀
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageTerm')

	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'MythOptionId')
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션 활성화 여부 확인
	if has_myth_option then
		--- 개화 데미지 계수
		self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'ModifierBase') +
			cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'ModifierAdd') * level

		--- 개화 범위
		radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'Radius')
	end

	--region assist info region
	do
		local size = vector(
			offset + distance * (limit_explosion - 1) + radius,
			bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y,
			math.sqrt(radius ^ 2 - (distance / 2) ^ 2) * 2
		)

		self.assist_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, nil, nil, true)
	end
	--endregion

	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, action_duration, cancelable_timing)
	self.explosion_state = explosion_state_class:new(
		self, max_hits, main_damage_scale, cast_radius, attack_timing,
		limit_explosion, radius, offset, distance, duration, term, damage_term
	)

	self.current_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	self.explosion_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.current_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.explosion_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.current_state_machine = nil
		self.explosion_state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.explosion_state)
		self.action_state = nil
		self.explosion_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.current_state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캐릭터를 제어함
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 캔슬 가능한 타이밍 이후만 런 캔슬 가능 하도록
	return self.current_state_machine:is_nil_state() == false and self.action_state:is_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 충돌체 정보 갱신
	assist_util.update_collision_info(
		self.assist_info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	)

	return assist_util.is_hittable(self.cs_action, self.assist_info, target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local trigger_info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.owner)

	--- 충돌체 정보 갱신
	assist_util.update_collision_info(
		self.assist_info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	)

	--- 방향 보정 얻어옴
	local dir_vector = assist_util.get_dir_vector_from_assistant(self.assist_info, self.owner)

	trigger_info:AppendDirection(dir_vector)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(
		self.owner, self.cs_action.HandleName, trigger_info)

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.owner.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self.action_state:set(dir_vector)
	self.explosion_state:set(dir_vector)

	self.current_state_machine:change(self.action_state)
	self.explosion_state_machine:change(self.explosion_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.current_state_machine:change(nil)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.explosion_state_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state_machine then self.current_state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.explosion_state_machine then self.explosion_state_machine:update(dt) end
end


--- 실제 대상에 데미지 처리
function local_class:apply_damage(target, scale)
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier) * scale

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end


return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 해변의 에이미 (summer_amy) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpSummerAmyBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
