--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 화이트데이 기르가스 (whiteday_girgas) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpWhitedayGirgasBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- hitabble distance
	self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		'cast',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner),
		parent_follow_flag.position
	)

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	--- instantiate screen fx
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
	--- play attack sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'screen')
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 점프 캔슬
	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)

	--- 이펙트 해제
	if self.fx_contrail then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_contrail)
		self.fx_contrail = nil
	end

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)

		--- 점프
		character_util.jump(self.owner, 3, self.dash_duration, 0.1, false)

		--- ground 이펙트 재생
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'ground', character_util.get_position(self.owner))

		--- contrail 이펙트 재생
		self.fx_contrail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'contrail',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			nil,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner),
			parent_follow_flag.position
		)
	end

	--- 첫 판정 타이밍 때 attack 이펙트 출력
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[1]) then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'attack', battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner)))

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.2)

		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

		--- play attack sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')
	end

	--- 다음 판정 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.5) then
		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, 0.2)
	end

	for idx = 1, #self.hit_timing do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍이 아니라면 생략
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- 피격 대상이 있다면
		if 0 < #fo_list then
			--- 액션 계수 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 데미지 스케일 계산
			local scale = idx == 1 and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale

			--- 데미지 부여
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, scale)
			end
		end

	until true end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 상태이상 수치 추가
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 드루이드 칸나(white_druid) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpWhiteDruidBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 공격 타이밍
	attack_timing = nil,
	--- 공격 오프셋
	offset = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 공격 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
	--- 공격 오프셋
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- instantiate cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.3)

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.current_time_passed < self.action_duration then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)
	end

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있는 경우
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.attack_timing then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- dash timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- short dash
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, false, 0
		)

		--- instantiate jump effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'jump', self.owner.Position)

		--- jump character
		character_util.jump(self.owner, 2.5, self.dash_duration)
	end

	--- attack timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 싱크 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.owner.Position + self.offset * self.dir_vector)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region area state

local area_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- aliment info
	aliment_info = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 범위
	radius = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 판정 시작 위치
	position = nil,
	--- 판정 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 영향을 준 대상
	hit_targets = {}
}
area_state_class.mt = { __index = area_state_class }

--- create area state
function area_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

end

function area_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 범위
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (#self.hit_timing - 1)
end

--- info sync
function area_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 판정 시작 위치
	self.position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 판정 방향

end

--- area state enter
function area_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, self.dir_vector.x > 0 and 'rexplosion' or 'explosion', self.position)

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')

	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.42)
end

--- area state exit
function area_state_class:exit(_)
	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.7)

	--- 영향을 준 타겟 리셋
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
	end
end

--- area state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function area_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do repeat
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 범위 내의 ifo
			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(self.position, self.radius)

			--- loop ifo
			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
				if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
					break
				end

				local scale = self.hit_targets[target] == nil and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale

				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)

				self.hit_targets[target] = true
			until true end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			--- reset state
			if index == #self.hit_timing then
				self.action.area_machine:change(nil)
			end
		end
	until true end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function area_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

---endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- area state
	self.area_state = area_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- area state machine
	self.area_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.area_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.area_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.area_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.area_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀 액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
	local dash_dist = self.action_state.dash_speed * self.action_state.dash_duration * 0.5

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_obj = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner),
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		dash_dist * direction
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	closest_obj = closest_obj or target

	local owner_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner)
	local closest_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_obj)

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(owner_bounds, closest_bounds, direction), dash_dist)

	return distance <=
		min_dist + self.action_state.offset + self.area_state.radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	--- 타겟 정보 추가
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 장판 정보 동기화
	self.area_state:sync(info)
	--- 장판 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.area_machine:change(self.area_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 판정 스테이트 캔슬
	self.area_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.area_machine then self.area_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 메인 이벤터 칼리 (wrestler) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpWrestlerBattleAction')

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = battle_state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')

	self.modifier_add_all = modifier_add * level;
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + self.modifier_add_all

	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 공격 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')

	--- 추적 타이밍
	self.trace_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TraceTiming')

	--- 공격 지속시간
	self.attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 판정 범위
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	self:apply_myth_option(param)

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.radius, height, self.attack_duration, nil, nil)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info,nil,0,1)

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')

	--- 대시 속도
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')

	--- 대시 지속시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')

	--- 옵션 적용 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션 적용시
	if activate_option then
		--- 전용 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 무옵 버프 정보
		self.cwp_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'Buff')
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_myth_option(param)

	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')

	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	--- 데미지 계수
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'ModifierBase')

	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'Radius')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + self.modifier_add_all
end


function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 타겟 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')

	--- screen 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'screen')
	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- instantiate screen fx
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		'cast',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		self.dir_vector
	)


	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	self.old_pos = self.trigger_pos
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- dash 해제
	if self.fx_dash then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_dash)
		self.fx_dash = nil
	end

	if self.current_time_passed < self.attack_timing then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'dash_end',
			character_util.get_position(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner),
			parent_follow_flag.position
		)
	end

	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
end

function action_state_class:force_cancel()
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 추적 시간까진 계속 추적
	--if old_time_passed < self.trace_timing then
	--	--- 대상 방향 갱신
	--	self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	--end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then

		--- set animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'dash')
		--- 대쉬 이펙트 생성
		self.fx_dash = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'dash',
			character_util.get_position(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner),
			parent_follow_flag.position
		)

		--- 대상 위치로 대쉬
		--battle_util.melee_short_dash(
		--	self.cs_action,
		--	nil,
		--	self.dir_vector,
		--	0,
		--	self.dash_duration,
		--	self.dash_speed,
		--	self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
		--	CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop,
		--	false,
		--	0
		--)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing, self.dash_timing + self.dash_duration) then
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInExpo(time_passed - self.dash_timing, 0, 1, self.dash_duration)

		progress = math.min(progress, 1)
		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.trigger_pos, self.target_pos, progress)

		--- 가상의 old_pos에 diff를 더해서
		local diff = new_pos - self.old_pos
		self.old_pos = self.old_pos + diff

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff.normalized, diff.magnitude, CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.3)
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * 1.0)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'explosion',
			battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.owner.Position) + self.dir_vector * 1.0,
			self.dir_vector
		)

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_dash, true)
		self.fx_dash = nil

	end

	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 판정 체크
		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 액션 계수 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end

			--- camera shake
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.2)
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기가 종료된 시점
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end

	self.current_time_passed = time_passed
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 상태이상 수치 추가
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action

		cs_action, params, nil,nil,nil,nil, myth_util.get_prefix_key(params, self.owner))

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = battle_state_machine:new(nil)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부

	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()

	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부

	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)

	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()

--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)


	local target_pos

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)

		target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(target))
	end

	--- 타겟 포지션이 없을 경우 dir vector 기반 위치를 넣음
	if not target_pos then
		target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner) + (dir_vector * self.action_state.search_range))
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- append target position
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, target_pos)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.action_state:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 수신관 제로스(xellos) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpXellosBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상 위치
	position = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param, _)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 공격 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상 위치
	self.position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	if character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner) == CS.Oak.Direction.Left and
		self.action.animation_info['actionl'] then
		--- set action animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'actionl')
	else
		--- set action animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	end

	--- set action emotion
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- instantiate cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- instantiate target effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'target', self.position, self.dir_vector)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.6)
	--- play default voice
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- 카메라 연출
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.3)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.current_time_passed < self.attack_timing then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)
	end

	--- remove emotion
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- attack timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 데이터 세팅
		self.action.area_state:start(self.position, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정 스테이트 머신 동작
		self.action.area_machine:change(self.action.area_state)
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region area state

local area_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- aliment info
	aliment_info = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 충돌체 길이
	length = nil,
	--- 충돌체 너비
	width = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 판정 시작 위치
	position = nil,
	--- 판정 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
area_state_class.mt = { __index = area_state_class }

--- create area state
function area_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function area_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	--- 충돌체 길이
	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 충돌체 너비
	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')

	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
		vector(self.length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.width)
	)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info)

	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (#self.hit_timing - 1)
end

--- info sync
function area_state_class:start(pos, dir)
	--- 대상 위치
	self.position = pos
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = dir
end

--- area state enter
function area_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.position, self.dir_vector)

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')

	--- 카메라 연출
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, self.hit_timing[#self.hit_timing] * 1.5)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.position)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
end

--- area state exit
function area_state_class:exit(_)
	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.7)
end

--- area state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function area_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do repeat
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) == false then
			break
		end

		--- 첫 히트
		local main_hit = index == 1

		--- play explosion sfx
		if main_hit then
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'main')
		elseif index == 2 then
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'sub')
		end

		--- 스케일
		local scale = main_hit and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale
		--- 데미지 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier) * scale

		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator)

		--- loop ifo
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
		until true end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		--- reset state
		if index == #self.hit_timing then
			self.action.area_machine:change(nil)
		end
	until true end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function area_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

---endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- area state
	self.area_state = area_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- area state machine
	self.area_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.area_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.area_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.area_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.area_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부

	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부

	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀 액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지

local local_class = newclass('EventFoxCatChargeBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.charge_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeSpeed", 15)
	self.charge_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDuration", 0.5)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.stun_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StunDuration", 1.5)

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		charging = 3,
		stun = 4,
		post = 5
	}
	self.current_state = self.state.none

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.hit_targets = {}
	self.target = nil
	self.charge_direction = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.IsMovementBlockedBetween(self.character, target, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) and
		vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude <= self.charge_duration * self.charge_speed
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 커맨드 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.charge_direction = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.hit_targets = {}
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if self.target == nil then return end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- Exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveEmotion()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation()
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.attack_range.gameObject)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charging then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation()
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stun then
		self.character:RemoveEmotion()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation()
	end

	-- Enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.character:SetEmotion('mad', true)
		self.character:SetAnimation('angry', true)

		self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,
				vector(self.charge_duration * self.charge_speed, self.character.Bounds.size.x))
		self.attack_range:Show(0.1)
	elseif next_state == self.state.charging then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassChargeCrashBehaviour(false, true)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character.Direction)
		self.character:SetAnimation('attack2', false)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_cat_hiss_01')
	elseif next_state == self.state.stun then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction)
		self.character:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
		self.character:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then return end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charging)
		else
			self.charge_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction)

			-- 계속 타겟을 바라봐줌
			local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction)
			if look_dir ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
				self.character.Direction = look_dir
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charging then

		-- 데미지 및 이벤트 처리
		for i = 0, self.character.CrashBehaviour.PushingTargets.Count - 1 do
			local target = self.character.CrashBehaviour.PushingTargets[i]
			if not table_util.contain_value(self.hit_targets, target) then
				local info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				info.sender = self.character
				info.target = target
				command_util.publish_damage(info)

				table.insert(self.hit_targets, target)
			end
		end

		local crashed_wall = false
		local movement = self.charge_speed * dt
		local sorted_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_collided_by(self.character.Bounds,
				self.charge_speed * dt * self.charge_direction)
		local dists = sorted_list.Keys
		local ifos = sorted_list.Values
		for i = 0, ifos.Count - 1 do
			local ifo = ifos[i]
			if (ifo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and
					not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(ifo.CrashBehaviour) then
				movement = dists[i].distance
				crashed_wall = true

				-- 화면 흔들기
				stage_camera:Shake(0.4, 0.3)

				-- 벽꿍 이팩트
				local wall_pos = self.character.Position + self.charge_direction * movement
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_wallimpact'):Instantiate(wall_pos)

				-- 자기 자신에게 데미지를 줌.
				local info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
				info.sender = self.character
				info.target = self.character
				info.damage = unity_class.mathf.Ceil(self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.2)
				command_util.publish_damage(info)

				-- Lv2바위에 부딪혔다면 바위를 부숴줌.
				if lua_helper.type_compare(ifo.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.RockDamagedBehaviour) then
					message_system:Send(ifo.DamagedBehaviour,
							CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'lv2_rock_destroy' }))
				end

				break
			end
		end
		sorted_list:Dispose()

		-- 이동 처리
		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
		move_info.magnitude = movement
		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, true)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

		if crashed_wall then
			self:change_state(self.state.stun)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.charge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stun then
		if self.time_passed >= self.stun_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

--변수 해제
function local_class:dispose()
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.hit_targets = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('EventFoxCatRoarBattleAction')

--region 떨어지는 낙석 객체 클래스

local falling_rock = {}
falling_rock.state = {
	none = 1,
	prepare = 2,
	fall = 3
}

falling_rock.prepare_duration = 0.1
falling_rock.hit_radius = 0.9
falling_rock.start_height = 10
falling_rock.rock_preset = 'fox_event_cat_rock_proj'
falling_rock.explosion_preset = 'break_cave_rock'

function falling_rock:start()
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function falling_rock:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then return end

	-- Exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self.pooled_rock:Dispose()
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.attack_range.gameObject)
		self.attack_range = nil
		self.free_fall = nil
	end

	-- Enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.hit_radius)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)
		self.attack_range:Show()
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.pooled_rock = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.rock_preset):Instantiate(
				vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos, self.start_height))
		self.free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(0, 20, self.start_height, 0)
		self.free_fall:ScaleTime(2)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function falling_rock:is_explode()
	return self.current_state == self.state.none or (self.current_state == self.state.fall and self.free_fall:IsDone())
end

function falling_rock:update_frame(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		if self.free_fall:IsDone() then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_rock_break_01')

			stage_camera:Shake(0.4, 0.3)

			local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.pooled_rock.transform.position)
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.explosion_preset):Instantiate(target_pos)

			local fos = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(target_pos, self.hit_radius)
			for i = 0, fos.Count - 1 do
				local target = fos[i]
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
					local info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
					info.sender = self.character
					info.target = target
					command_util.publish_damage(info)
				end
			end
			fos:Dispose()

			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		else
			self.free_fall:Proceed(dt)
			self.pooled_rock.transform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.pooled_rock.transform.position,
					self.free_fall:GetDistance())
		end
	end
end

function falling_rock:dispose()

		self.pooled_rock:Dispose()
	end

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.attack_range.gameObject)
	end

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.free_fall = nil
end

function falling_rock:new(character, target_pos)
	local inst = {}
	inst.time_passed = 0
	inst.current_state = self.state.none
	inst.target_pos = target_pos
	inst.character = character
	setmetatable(inst, { __index = self })
	return inst
end

--endregion

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.shot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotInterval", 0.9)
	self.num_of_shots = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "NumberOfShots", 10)
	self.num_of_random_shot = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "NumberOfRandomShot", 2)

	_, _, self.preset_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_battle_action, params)

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3
	}
	self.current_state = self.state.none

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.shoot_count = 0

	self.falling_rocks = {}
	self.target = nil
	self.battle_bound = nil
	self.shootable_points = {}
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 커맨드 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.shoot_count = 0
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if self.target == nil then return end

	-- 쏠수있는 지역들을 매핑한다.
	if #self.shootable_points == 0 then
		local diameter = 1
		local area_width = math.floor(self.battle_bound.size.x)
		local area_height = math.floor(self.battle_bound.size.z)
		local area_lb = vector_util.get_x0z(self.battle_bound.center) +
				unity_class.vector3.left * (area_width / 2) + unity_class.vector3.back * (area_height / 2)
		for y = 0, area_height - 1 do
			for x = 0, area_width - 1 do
				local x_offset = unity_class.vector3.right * (diameter / 2.0 + x)
				local z_offset = unity_class.vector3.forward * (diameter / 2.0 + y)
				local target_point = area_lb + x_offset + z_offset
				table.insert(self.shootable_points, target_point)
			end
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- Exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveEmotion()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation()
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	 --Enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character.Direction))
		self.character:SetEmotion('mad', true)
		self.character:SetAnimation('victory_extra', true)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_cat_meow_01')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_frame_always(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then return end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.shoot_count >= self.num_of_shots then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.shot_interval then
			-- 쏠 지점 탐색
			local shot_points = { self.target.Position }
			for _ = 1, self.num_of_random_shot do
				local point = self.shootable_points[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.shootable_points)]
				table.insert(shot_points, point)
			end

			-- 쏠 지점에 종유석 투하
			for _, point in ipairs(shot_points) do
				local rock = falling_rock:new(self.character, point)
				rock:start()
				self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1
				table.insert(self.falling_rocks, rock)
			end

			self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.shot_interval
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame_always(dt)
	for i = #self.falling_rocks, 1, -1 do
		local rock = self.falling_rocks[i]
		if rock:is_explode() then
			table.remove(self.falling_rocks, i)
		end

		rock:update_frame(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	for _, rock in ipairs(self.falling_rocks) do
		rock:dispose()
	end
	self.falling_rocks = {}

	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	falling_rock = nil
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	}
	self.current_state = self.state.none

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fx_pool_name):Instantiate(self.character.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0),
				self:get_fx_rot(self.character.Direction), self.character.Transform)

		self:setup_calculator()
		if self.collision_calculator ~= nil then
			local targets = self.collision_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
			for i = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
				local target = targets[i]
				local info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				info.sender = self.character
				info.target = target
				command_util.publish_damage(info)

	info.Duration = CS.System.Single.MaxValue
	info.Radius = self.radius
	info.Angle = self.angle
	info.Height = self.character.Bounds.size.y
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.Direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))

function local_class:is_loaded()

end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

function local_class:start(info)

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_combo()

end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

		return
	end

	--  Exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation.state:Event('-', self.on_hit)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation()
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	--Enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if not self:is_combo() then
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
			self.character:SetAnimation('angry', true)
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation.state:Event('+', self.on_hit)
		self.character:SetAnimation('attack2', false)

		self.dash_directon = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character.Direction)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:get_fx_rot(dir)
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(180, unity_class.vector3.right) * unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.up)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(270, unity_class.vector3.up)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(180, unity_class.vector3.up)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		 return unity_class.quaternion.identity
	end

	return unity_class.quaternion.identity
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then return end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 계속 타겟을 바라봐줌
		local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		if look_dir ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			self.character.Direction = look_dir
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration or self:is_combo() then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then

			if self.max_combo_count > 0 and self.current_combo + 1 <= self.max_combo_count then
				self.current_combo = self.current_combo + 1
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.none)
			end
		else
			-- 대쉬 이동 처리
			local speed = self.dash_dist / self.action_duration
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.dash_directon
			move_info.magnitude = speed * dt
			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.character.Direction, true)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

--변수 해제
function local_class:dispose()
	self.on_hit = nil
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	)

	end

	if character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner) == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then

	elseif character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner) == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_duration) then

	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.damage = 100

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

end

function local_class:update_frame(_)
	--- 체크해야되는 플래그가 활성화 되어있을때
	if self.check_flag then
		--- 현재 타일 타입 가져옴
		local type = field:GetTileInfoAt(self.owner.Position).types

		--- 타일 타입 체크
		if (type & CS.Tilemaps.TileTypes.Sliding) == CS.Tilemaps.TileTypes.None then
			return false
		end

		--- 바라보고 있는 방향
		local direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))

		--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
		local blocking = field:IsAnythingBlockingWithoutBounds(
			bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner), CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, 0.36 * direction
		)

		--- 블로킹되는 것이 없다면 슬라이드 상태에 들어가도록
		if blocking == false then
			--- 안전하게 배틀액션 모두 캔슬
			self.owner.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions()

			--- 슬라이드 상태로 전환
			message_system:Send(self.owner.CharacterBehaviour,
				CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.SlideState.Create(self.owner, direction)))
		else
			self.owner:OnEvent(CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviourResetEvent.Instance)
		end
	end
end

end

function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	--- 스테이트 리셋시 플래그 초기화
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviourResetEvent) then
		self.check_flag = false
		return false
	end

	--- 이벤트 체크
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent) == false then
		return false
	end

	--- 바뀔 스테이트
	local state = e.State

	--- 바뀔 스테이트 체크
	if lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.ShortDashState) then
		self.check_flag = true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.SlideState) then
		self.check_flag = false
	end

	return false
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 타겟 탐색
	local _, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_battle_action, self.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, dir_vector)

	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * dir_vector

	trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, shoot_pos)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- Sync 방향 데이터
	self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	self.shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)

	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	--- state change
	self:change_state(self.state.action)

	self:shoot_proj(self.sync_dir_vector,  self.shoot_pos)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소

end

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.sync_dir_vector)

	-- 스펙 기반 발사 사운드 재생
	projectile_spec_util.play_shoot_sfx(self.proj_spec[1])

	--- 액션 키 재생
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_battle_action, 'action')

	--- 스태미나 사용
	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_battle_action)

	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.sync_dir_vector, center)
end

function local_class:exit_action_state(next_state)
	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

	--- 다음 액션이 none 일때 (액션이 종료되었을때)
	if next_state and next_state.id ~= self.state.action.id then

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

--- 스테이트 업데이트 프레임

--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 액션 종료
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 공격 버튼이 눌려 있고 공격이 가능한 스태미나양을 가지고 있다면
		if self.attacking and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_battle_action) then
			--- 공격이 가능한 상태
			if battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_battle_action) then
				--- 원거리 타겟 탐색
				_, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
					self.cs_battle_action, self.search_range, false, true
				)

				self.shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.sync_dir_vector

				self:shoot_proj(self.sync_dir_vector,  self.shoot_pos)

				--- 스테이트 재갱신
				self:change_state(self.state.action)
			end
		else
			if battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_battle_action) then
				self:change_state(self.state.none)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.reload)
			end

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish

		end
	end
end

	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, dir_vector)

	local random_angle = (random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5) * 10
	local bounce_dir_vector = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_angle, 0) * dir_vector

	CS.Oak.ActionEffectHelper.RequestCartridgeBounce(center, bounce_dir_vector)

	effect_util.instantiate_effect(self.proj_spec[1].HitPreset, hit_info.position)

		self:apply_damage(hit_info.target, move_info.direction, label, hit_info.position)

function local_class:update_slash_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
			stage_camera:Shake(0.04, 0.05)
		end

		local slash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'slash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.sync_dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.sync_dir_vector)

		--- 방향에 맞는 스케일
		if self.attack_type == 'slash' then
			if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
			elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
			elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
			elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
			end
		else
			if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
			elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
			elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
			elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
			end
		end

		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'slash')
	end

	--- 공격이 진행 중
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
				self:apply_damage(target, self.owner.Bounds.center, self.attack_modifier, 16000)
			end
		end

		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 공격 완료
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end

	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state.update then
		self.current_state.update(self, old_time_passed, self.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self.action_duration <= old_time_passed then

		--- state reset
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화

	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if self.finished_time_passed > combo_window then

			self:change_state(self.state.none)

		end

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_battle_action, 'action')

	--- set action emo
	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_battle_action, 'action')

	--- play slash sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'slash')

	battle_util.melee_short_dash(
		self.cs_battle_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector,
		self.hit_timing, self.dash_duration,
		self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
		nil, false, 0
	)

	--- to 4-way vector3
	self.sync_dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(direction)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 초기 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.sync_dir_vector)

	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
end

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
