--[[	None,
--		Start, //이벤트 시작 트리거
--		ReserveRequest, //대상 몬스터를 예약함
--		ReserveResponse, //대상 몬스터를 예약 취소
--		ReserveCancelRequest,
--		ReserveCancelResponse,
--		ResourceDead,
--		StarterDead,
--		Move,  //재료 몬스터가 이동했을때 알림
--		Fail, //이벤트 중 몬스터가 죽었을 때 실패
--		Success, //이벤트 정상 완료
--		End //이벤트 종료
]]--

function local_class:on_event(e)
    if self.character.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
        return false
    end

    if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEvent) then
        if e.Sender == nil or e.Sender == self.character then
            return false
        end

        if e.Type == CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.ReserveResponse then
            if self.character == e.Sender then return false end

            if e.Expression ~= CS.Oak.FusionExpressionType.Success then return false end

            local resource = e.Sender

            self.resources:Add(resource)
        elseif e.Type == CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.ResourceDead then
            if e.Sender == nil then return false end
            if self.resources:Contains(e.Sender) == false then return false end
            self:cancel()

            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end


--[[	None,
--		Start, //이벤트 시작 트리거
--		ReserveRequest, //대상 몬스터를 예약함
--		ReserveResponse, //대상 몬스터를 예약 취소
--		ReserveCancelRequest,
--		ReserveCancelResponse,
--		ResourceDead,
--		StarterDead,
--		Move,  //재료 몬스터가 이동했을때 알림
--		Fail, //이벤트 중 몬스터가 죽었을 때 실패
--		Success, //이벤트 정상 완료
--		End //이벤트 종료
]]--
function local_class:on_fusion_event(e)
    if self.character.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
        return false
    end

    -- 보낸 사람이 나거나 없다면 취소
    if e.Sender == nil or e.Sender == self.character then return false end


    -- 1. 무빙해서 스타터 영역으로 들어 왔다. 내게 조인 가능한지 물어본다
    if e.Type == CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.ResourceMove then

        --스캔중이 아니면 응답할 필요는 없다.
        if self.current_state ~= self.state.scan then return false end

        -- 이미 조건은 충족 했다.
        if self.resources.Count >= self.search_mob_count then return false end

        local resource = e.Sender

        --움직인 재료 몬스터가 죽어있어도 할거 없다
        if resource.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead == true then return false end

        --합체 거리 밖이라면 아무것도 안한다
        local dist = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, resource.Position)
        if dist > self.search_radius then return false end

        -- ★★★ 모든 조건을 충족했다. ★★★
        message_system:SendSync(resource,
                CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEvent.Create(
                    self.character,
                    CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.ReserveRequest
        ))

    end
end

function local_class:release_all_resource()

    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEvent.Create(
            self.character,
            CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.ReserveCancelRequest
    ))
    self.resources:Clear()
    --[[for _, resource in pairs(self.resources) do
        --각자에게 예약 취소를 보낸다)
        message_system:SendSync(resource,
                CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEvent.Create(
                    self.character,
                    CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.ReserveCancelRequest
        ))
    end]]--
end

--region event
function local_class:on_field_obj_destroyed_event(e)
    if self.character.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
        return false
    end

    if self.target == nil then
        return
    end

    if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.target) then
        local resource = e.FieldObject
        self.resources:Remove(resource)
    end
end
--endregion


--region util
function local_class:fusion()
    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEvent.Create(
            self.character,
            CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.Success
    ))
    self.resources:Clear()

    --[[
        if self.resources.Count > 0 then
            for _, resource in pairs(self.resources) do
                message_system:SendSync(resource, CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEvent.Create(
                        self.character,
                        CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEventType.Success
                ))
            end
        end
    ]]--

end

function local_class:kill_self()
    if lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) == false then
        return
    end

    self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Disappear
    self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false

    local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
    damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
    damage_info.sender = self.character
    damage_info.target = self.character
    damage_info.damage = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
    command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

    self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
end

-- ☆☆☆☆☆☆ 무적 처리
function local_class:set_invincible()
    if self.character.DamagedBehaviour ~= CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance then
        self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
    end
end
function local_class:remove_invincible()
    -- 아닌 경우에만 할당한다
    if self.character.DamagedBehaviour ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) == false then
        self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create();
    end
end

--endregion

-------- 관리 함수 --------
function local_class:is_loaded()
    return true
end
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
    return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
    self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:cancel()
    self:change_state(self.state.none)
    self.character:RemoveAnimation()
    self.character:RemoveEmotion()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
    self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
    self:cancel()

    self.cs_battle_action = nil
    self.character = nil
    self.target = nil

    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExpeditionFusionEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

    self.anim_key_prepare = nil
    self.anim_key_scan = nil
    self.expedition_system = nil
    self.resources:Clear()
    self.resources = nil

    if self.fx_scan ~= nil then
        self.fx_scan:Dispose()
        self.fx_scan = nil
    end

    if self.fx_fusion ~= nil then
        self.fx_fusion:Dispose()
        self.fx_fusion = nil
    end

    self.scan_range = nil
    self.state = nil
end

return {
    create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
        return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
    end,
}

--- 18챕터 머니샷(격투게임) 플레이어블 캐릭터의 가드 및 패리
local local_class = newclass('GuardHeavenholdRobotBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 스턴 방어 세팅
	self.cs_action.StunDefense = stun_constants.factor_normal_strong
	--- 넉백 방어 세팅
	self.cs_action.KnockBackDefense = knock_back_constants.factor_normal_strong

	--- 패리 판정 타이밍과 유지시간
	self.parry_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ParryTiming')
	local parry_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ParryDuration')
	self.parry_end = self.parry_timing + parry_duration

	self.on_touch_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_touch_event(e)
	end

	--- 가드 종료용 이벤트
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), self.on_touch_event_func)

	self.guard_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param)
	self.parry_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'Parry')

	self.guard_end_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostActionDuration')
end

--- dispose state
function action_state_class:dispose()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), self.on_touch_event_func)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.right
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 격겜이라 오른쪽만 본다.
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 공격 애니메이션
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.guard_buff_info)
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.parry_buff_info)

	self.is_parry_success = false
	self.post_action_timing = 0
	self.is_guard_end = false
	battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'cast')

end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'end')

	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.guard_buff_info.name)
	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.parry_buff_info.name)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.parry_end) then
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.parry_buff_info.name)
	end

	if self.is_guard_end then
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.post_action_timing) then

			self:state_end()
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_touch_event(e)
	--- 이렇게 직접 받아서 하면 안되다.
	--- 미니겜용이니깐 허용. 정식 캐릭터는 절대절대 하면 안됨.
	if self.cs_action.IsActive == false then return end

	--- 패리상태로 진입되지 않았을 때만 가드를 캔슬한다.
	--- 패리중이라면 캔슬하지 않느다.
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) and self.is_guard_end == false then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.TouchEventType, CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SpecialFunction3TouchUp) then
			--self:state_end()
			buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.guard_buff_info.name)
			buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.parry_buff_info.name)

			self.is_guard_end = true
			self.post_action_timing = self.current_time_passed + self.guard_end_duration
			--- remove animation
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
			--- 공격 애니메이션
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'end')
		end
	end
	return false
end

function action_state_class:state_end()
	self.machine:change(nil)
	--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

function action_state_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoneyShotEvent) then
		if e.EventType ~= CS.Oak.MoneyShotEventType.Damage then return end
		--- 스킬 미 작동중이면 패스
		if self.cs_action.IsActive == false then return end

		local is_light_attack = e.AttackTag == CS.Oak.MoneyShotAttackTag.LightAttack

		--- 패리 타이밍에만 처리
		if self.current_time_passed < self.parry_timing or self.current_time_passed > self.parry_end then return end
		---
		if self.is_parry_success == true then return end

		--- 내가 보낸 데미지 무시
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.owner) then return end

		-- if is_light_attack then return end

		--- 패리 성공
		self.is_parry_success = true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BuffAddEvent) then
		if self.cs_action.IsActive == false and e.Buff.BuffSpec.Name == self.guard_buff_info.name then

--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부

	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성

	end

	self.action_state:on_event(e)
	return false
end

local local_class = newclass('GuardianWolfDashBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 2)

	self.interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "IntervalDuration", 0.25)
	self.repeat_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RepeatCount", 3)

	self.charge_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeDistance", 15)
	local charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeWidth", 2)
	local damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 0.25)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.0)

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(self.charge_distance, charge_width))
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = damage_term
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.Extents = unity_class.vector3(charge_width / 2, 2, charge_width / 2)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		interval = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) < self.charge_distance
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 돌진 대상 커맨드
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self.current_action_count = 0

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.synced = nil
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.last_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.last_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(0)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.last_direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_action_count = self.current_action_count + 1
		self.synced = false
		self.charge_direction = self.last_direction
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction)
		-- 돌진 시작
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.last_direction)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.last_direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("interval")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.last_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		if not self.last_direction:IsAlmostZero() then
			if self.zone_bound ~= nil then
				self.last_direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, self.last_direction)
			end

			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.last_direction)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.last_direction)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.action_duration * dt

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
					local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
					local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
					local knock_direction
					if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
					else
						knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		else
			-- 충돌 이벤트 감지 없이 스테이트 시간 초과 시 스테이트 전환.
			if self.current_action_count < self.repeat_count then
				self.last_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
				if self.zone_bound ~= nil then
					self.last_direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, self.last_direction)
				end
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	-- Active 상태일 때만 sync.
	if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(info:GetNumberAt(0, -1))
		if self.current_action_count + 1 == idx then
			self.last_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
			if self.current_action_count < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.action and not self.synced then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if not is_unity_null(blocker) then
				if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
					self.synced = true

					-- 다음 돌진 위해 싱크 커맨드
					local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
					info:AppendNumber(self.current_action_count + 1)

					local dir_to_charge = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
					if self.zone_bound ~= nil then
						dir_to_charge = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, dir_to_charge)
					end

					info:AppendDirection(dir_to_charge)

					local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
					command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then return false end
	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then return false end

	--- 트리거 정보만 구성하여 트리거한다. 타겟은 액션 중간에 선정한다.
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
	return true
end

-- start
function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = nil
	self.scan_time_passed = 0
	self.prev_progress = 0
	if self.last_move_point == nil then
		self.last_move_point = self.character
	end
	self:change_state(self.state.scan)
end

--state change
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then return	end

	-- Exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.scan then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.scan_range))
		self.scan_range:Hide()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
		self:release_target(self.target)
		self:remove_invincible()
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.back_jump then
		--- 현재 할당된 크래시 비헤비어가 존재할때
		if self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour ~= nil then
			--- 크래시 비헤비어 떼기
			battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
			--- 크래시 비헤비어 할당 해제
			self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		end
	end

	-- Enter
	if next_state == self.state.scan then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:play_scan_animation()
		self.target = nil

		if self.show_scan_range == true then
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.scan_range, self.character.Position, 0)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.scan_range))
			self.scan_range:Show()
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		-- 방향 고정
		local dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_time))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:play_prepare_animation()



	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.prev_progress = 0
		self:set_head_offset(self.target)
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = self.head_offset
		self.target_pos = self.target.Position
		self:lock_target(self.target)
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'HeadCrabAttatched', self.target.Name }))

		local dist = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.target.Position)
		local ratio = dist / self.jump_distance
		local jump_height = self.jump_height * ratio
		self.jump_duration = self.anim_jump_duration

		character_util.jump(self.character, jump_height, self.jump_duration)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:play_jump_animation()
		self:set_invincible()

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:play_hug_animation()

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true


	elseif next_state == self.state.back_jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.prev_progress = 0
		self.jump_duration = self.anim_jump_duration
        self.last_move_point = self.character.Position  --마지막 이동 위치가 현재 자리.
		self.back_jump_pos = self:get_random_position(self.jump_distance, self.jump_direction_count)

		character_util.jump(self.character, self.jump_height, self.jump_duration)
		--- 충돌 무시 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:play_jump_animation()

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		if self.target ~= nil then
			self:release_target(self.target)
		end
		self.fx_scan = nil
		self:remove_invincible()

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:play_scan_animation()
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.anim_key_scan)
	if self.fx_scan == nil then
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('scan')
		--battle_util.play_sfx(self.cs_battle_action, 'scan')
		self.fx_scan = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("fx_scan", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	end
end
function local_class:play_prepare_animation()
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.anim_key_prepare)
end
function local_class:play_jump_animation()
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.anim_key_jump)
end
function local_class:play_hug_animation()
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.anim_key_hug)
end

--region update
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	--대상이 없으면 마저 스캔한다.
	if self.current_state == self.state.scan then
		if self:is_valid_target(self.target) == true then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		else
			self.scan_time_passed = self.scan_time_passed + dt
			if self.scan_time_passed < self.scan_time then
				self.target = self:get_target()
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)    --스캔을 했지만 아무도 없다. 종료한다.
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self:is_valid_target(self.target) == false then	--준비시간동안 대상이 유효하지 않다면 다시 스캔한다.
			self:change_state(self.state.scan)
		else
			if self.time_passed > self.prepare_time then
				self:change_state(self.state.jump)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attach')
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then		--점프 시점에 확정 달라 붙기
		if self:update_jump(dt) then	--일단은 날아간다.
			--도착햇는데 대상이 죽어있다면
			if character_util.is_dead(self.target) == true then
				message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'HeadCrabQuickJump' }))
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
				return
			end
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if character_util.is_dead(self.target) == false then
			self:update_pos(dt)
			if self.time_passed > self.action_time then
				self:change_state(self.state.back_jump)
			end
		else
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'HeadCrabQuickJump' }))
			self:change_state(self.state.back_jump)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.back_jump then
		if self:update_back_jump(dt) then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	else

	end
end

function local_class:update_pos(dt)
	self.target_pos = self.target.Position
	self.character.Position = self.target_pos
end

function local_class:update_jump(dt)
	self.target_pos = self.target.Position + self.head_offset
	local dist = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.target_pos)
	if dist <= self.near_distance or self.time_passed > self.jump_duration then
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos)
		return true
	end

	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration)
	local progress_dt = progress - self.prev_progress

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = vector_util.normalized(self.target_pos - self.character.Position)
	move_info.magnitude = self.jump_distance * progress_dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_side_dir(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
	self.prev_progress = progress
	return false
end

function local_class:update_back_jump(dt)
	local target_pos = self.back_jump_pos
	local dist = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, target_pos)
	if dist <= self.near_distance or self.time_passed > self.max_jump_duration * 0.5 then
		return true
	end

	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.max_jump_duration * 0.5)
	local progress_dt = progress - self.prev_progress

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = vector_util.normalized(target_pos - self.character.Position)
	move_info.magnitude = self.jump_distance * progress_dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_side_dir(move_info.direction), false)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
	self.prev_progress = progress
	return false
end
--endregion


--region event
function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if self.character.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if self.character == e.Sender then return false end	--내가 보낸건 무시한다.

		--내가 보낸게 아니라면 중복으로 대상에게 달려들지 않는다.
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'HeadCrabAttatched' then
			local character_name = e:GetParamAt(1)
			if self.target == nil or character_name == nil then return false end

			if self.target.Name == character_name then
				self:change_state(self.state.scan)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_party_switch_event(e)
	if self.character.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
		return false
	end

	self:release_target(self.target)
	self:change_state(self.state.back_jump)
end

function local_class:on_field_obj_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.character.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
		return false
	end

	if self.target == nil then return end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.target) then
		self:release_target(self.target)
		self:change_state(self.state.back_jump)
	end
end
--endregion


--region util
function local_class:set_head_offset(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		local spec = CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCharacterSpec(target)
		if spec ~= nil then
			-- 캉, 하얀야수
			if spec.OriginId == 13 or spec.OriginId == 244 then
				self.head_offset = vector(0, 0.4, -0.05)
			--유진과 터미네이터
			elseif spec.OriginId == 338 or spec.OriginId == 428 then
				self.head_offset = vector(0, 0.9, -0.05)
			else
				self.head_offset = vector(0, 0.5, -0.05)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 대상의 제어권을 뺏는다.
function local_class:lock_target(target)
	if is_unity_null(target) == true then return end

	--애니메이션 세트, 루프

	if summonable_util.get_master(target) ~= nil then
		local spec = CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCharacterSpec(target)
		if spec ~= nil then
			if spec.OriginId == 500301 or spec.OriginId == 500401 then
				target:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)
				target:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
			end
		end
	else
		--매드팬더 변신이 아닐때만 붙여준다
		target:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)
		target:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
	end

	--persistant 배틀 액션류는 EndBattleAction 호출하여 종료 처리 해야 함.
	-- 배틀액션 캔슬 되기 전에 호출 해야 한다.
	target.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	target.CharacterBehaviour:EndAllPersistentBattleActions()

	-- 스피드캡 버프
	buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.speed_cap_buff_name, 1, false, false)
	if battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
		local state = target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
		if state ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
			-- 현재 조작하는 캐릭터라면 입력을 막음
			target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RequestDisableControl(target, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
		end
	else
		local controller = target.FieldObjectController
		cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
	end

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.stunFactor = stun_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.stunDuration = self.action_time

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end
-- 대상의 제어권을 복구한다
function local_class:release_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		-- 애니메이션 제거
		target:RemoveAnimation()
		target:RemoveEmotion()
		-- 스피드캡 버프 제거
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.speed_cap_buff_name)

		if battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
			local state = target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
			if state ~= nil and	lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
				-- 현재 조작하는 캐릭터라면 막혀있던 입력을 풀어줌
				target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RemoveDisableControl(target)
			end
		else
			local controller = target.FieldObjectController
			if controller == nil then
				print('#3#[HeadCrabTrap][Error] ')
				return
			end

			cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
			controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Enabled
		end
	end
end

-- 무적 및 대상 지정 불가로 변경
function local_class:set_invincible()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance

	--- 충돌 무시 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 붙이기
	battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
end

-- 무적 해제 및 대상 지정 가능하도록 변경
function local_class:remove_invincible()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create();

	--- 현재 할당된 크래시 비헤비어가 존재할때
	if self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour ~= nil then
		--- 크래시 비헤비어 떼기
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
		--- 크래시 비헤비어 할당 해제
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	end
end

function local_class:get_target()
	local target_list = party_manager.UserParty
	local target = nil
	local target_dist = 999999
	for _, victim in pairs(target_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, victim) then

			local summons_list = summonable_util.get_summonables(victim)
			for _, summons in pairs(summons_list) do
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, summons) and self:is_valid_target(summons) then
					local summons_dist = vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position), vector_util.get_x0z(summons.Position))
					if summons_dist < self.scan_distance and summons_dist < target_dist then
						target_dist = summons_dist
						target = summons
					end
				end
			end

			if self:is_valid_target(victim) then
				local victim_dist = vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position), vector_util.get_x0z(victim.Position))
				if victim_dist < self.scan_distance and victim_dist < target_dist then
					target_dist = victim_dist
					target = victim
				end
			end
		end

	end

	return target
end

function local_class:is_valid_target(target)
	if is_unity_null(target) == true then
		return false
	end

	--거리 체크
	local dist = vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position), vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position))
	if dist > self.jump_distance then
		return false
	end

	--이미 한놈이 점유하고 있다
	if target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:IsActiveBuff(self.speed_cap_buff_id) then
		return false
	end

	--이미 죽었다.
	if character_util.is_dead(target) == true then
		return false
	end

	return true
end


--360/N 각도를 무작위로 얻어 distance 만큼 떨어진 위치를 얻는다.
function local_class:get_random_position(distance, count)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		return self.character.Position
	end

	local dest_pos, dest_dir = pattern_util.random_direction_point(self.character, distance, self.jump_angle, true)

	if dest_pos == nil or dest_pos == vector_util.zeor then
		dest_pos = self.character.Position
	end

	self.last_move_point = dest_pos
	return dest_pos
end
--endregion

-------- 관리 함수 --------
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.target ~= nil then
		self:release_target(self.target)
		self.target:RemoveAnimation()
		self.target:RemoveEmotion()
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation()
	self.character:RemoveEmotion()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.anim_key_hug = nil
	self.anim_key_hug_ready = nil
	self.anim_key_jump = nil
	self.anim_key_prepare = nil
	self.anim_key_scan = nil

	self.head_offset = nil

	self.scan_range = nil

	self.speed_cap_buff_name = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil

end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	end

	-- 타겟 위치 커맨드 생성
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.moved_vector)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:set_attack_range(moved_vector)
	self.moved_vector = moved_vector
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.moved_vector = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	self.attack_dir = -vector_util.normalized(self.moved_vector)
	local size = unity_class.vector2(vector_util.magnitude(self.moved_vector), self.wall_width)
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, size)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.attack_dir)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.virtual_wall = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	self.virtual_wall.Name = 'ice_wall'
	if math.abs(self.moved_vector.x) > math.abs(self.moved_vector.z) then
		self.virtual_wall.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(self.attack_range.Size.x, self.wall_height, self.attack_range.Size.y))
	else
		self.virtual_wall.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(self.attack_range.Size.y, self.wall_height, self.attack_range.Size.x))
	end
	self.virtual_wall.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.virtual_wall.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
	self.virtual_wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	table.insert(self.gen_walls, self.virtual_wall)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
			self.attack_range:Hide()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_range:Show()

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.cast_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare')
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.destroy then
		self:update_destroy_wall(dt)

		-- NOTE: update_destroy_wall 내부에서 time_passed 처리 하므로 여기서 return 안하면 시간이 2배로 빨리 감김.
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			--얼음생성
			self:generate_ice_wall()
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:generate_ice_wall()
	for i = 1, self.attack_range.Size.x do
		for j = 1, self.attack_range.Size.y do
			local side_dir = unity_class.vector3(self.attack_dir.z, 0, self.attack_dir.x)
			local pos = self.character.Position + (self.attack_dir * (i-0.5) + side_dir * (j - self.attack_range.Size.y / 2 - 0.5))
			table.insert(self.effects, self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.wall_fx_key, pos, self.attack_dir))
		end
	end

	local p = self.attack_range.CacheTransform.position
	self.virtual_wall.Position = p
	self.virtual_wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	-- sfx
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('impact', p)

	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.virtual_wall.Bounds, vector_util.zero)

	for _, v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, v) then
			local side_dir = vector_util.normalized(unity_class.vector3(-self.moved_vector.z, 0, self.moved_vector.x))
			if vector_util.dot(v.Position - self.virtual_wall.Position, side_dir) < 0 then
				side_dir = -side_dir
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.modifier = self.attack_modifier
			damage_info.knockBackForce = self.knockback_force *  CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.knockback_factor
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = side_dir
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_destroy_wall(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed > self.wall_duration then
		local sfx_played = false
		for i = 1, #self.effects do
			local p = self.effects[i].transform.position
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.wall_end_fx_key, p)
			self.effects[i]:Dispose()

			if not sfx_played then
				sfx_played = true
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('break', p)
			end
		end
		self.effects = nil

		for i = 1, #self.gen_walls do
			self.gen_walls[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			self.gen_walls[i] = nil
		end
		self.gen_walls = nil

		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end
end

function local_class:on_destroy_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.character) then
		return
	end
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	self:change_state(self.state.destroy)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.gen_walls = nil
	self.virtual_wall = nil

	self.wall_width = nil
	self.wall_height = nil
	self.cast_duration = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('JingakBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	local attack_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AnimationAttackStartTiming', 0.5);
	local stomp_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AnimationActualStompTiming', 0.66);
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0.5);
	self.attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackDuration', 0.5);
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 0.8);
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 2);
	self.stomp_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Radius', 7.0);
	self.stomp_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Angle', 55.0);
	self.stomp_section_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'SectionCount', 4);

	local has_value, animation_info = self.cs_battle_action.AnimationInfos:TryGetValue('stomp')
	local animation_name = animation_info.name
	local animation_time = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(self.character.SpineController, animation_name)
	self.prepare_timescale = attack_timing / self.prepare_duration
	self.action_timescale = (animation_time - attack_timing) / self.attack_duration
	self.attack_timing = stomp_timing * (self.attack_duration + self.prepare_duration) / animation_time - self.prepare_duration

	self.attack_ranges = {}
	self.calculators = {}

	for i = 0, self.stomp_section_count - 1 do
		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateArc(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.stomp_radius, self.stomp_angle,
				CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		attack_range:Hide()
		self.attack_ranges[i] = attack_range
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.stomp_radius
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	self.target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if self.target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd);

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		for i = 0, self.stomp_section_count - 1 do
			self.calculators[i]:End()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.trigger_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('stomp')
		self.character.SpineController.TimeScale = self.prepare_timescale
		for i = 0, self.stomp_section_count - 1 do
			local attack_range = self.attack_ranges[i]

			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.stomp_section_count, 0) * self.trigger_direction
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, self.character.Position, dir)
			attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.attack_timing)

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, attack_range))

			local info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()
			info.Center = self.character.Position
			info.Direction = dir
			info.DamageTerm = -1
			info.Duration = self.attack_duration
			info.Radius = self.stomp_radius
			info.Angle = self.stomp_angle
			local attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true)

			self.calculators[i] = attack_calculator
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.SpineController.TimeScale = self.action_timescale
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		--- none 스테이트 들어온 경우 애니메이션 삭제
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.attack_timing then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp1')
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp2')
			local pos = vector(self.character.Position.x, self.character.Position.y + 0.03, self.character.Position.z)
			for i = 0, self.stomp_section_count - 1 do
				local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.stomp_section_count, 0) * self.trigger_direction
				local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('stomp', pos, dir)
				effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(dir, unity_class.vector3.up)
				effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.stomp_radius / 6

				local attack_range = self.attack_ranges[i]
				attack_range:Hide()
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, attack_range))

				local attack_calculator = self.calculators[i]
				attack_calculator:Start()
				local objects = attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects[index]
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
						local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
						local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, fo)

						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = direction
						if dist > 4 then
							damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
							damage_info.knockBackDirection = -direction
							damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce + 11000
						end

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end
				end
				objects:Dispose()
			end

			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration + self.attack_duration - self.attack_timing then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	for i = 0, self.stomp_section_count - 1 do
		local attack_range = self.attack_ranges[i]
		attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, attack_range))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.attack_ranges = nil
	self.calculators = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('JumpStompBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 0.667)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 2)
	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackRadius', 3)
	local attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackDelay', 0)
	local attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackDuration', 0.18)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 0.5)
	self.action_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDistance', 5)
	self.jump_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'JumpHeight', 2)

	-- 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = attack_duration
	info.Radius = self.attack_radius
	info.Height = 3
	info.IsCenterToBottom = true
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, attack_delay, 1)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.action_distance
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	if not self:is_hittable(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- FIX?: 타겟 없으면 방향으로 일정거리 나아가게 해야 하나?
	-- 타겟 위치 커맨드 생성
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target.Position)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.base_position = self.character.Position
	self.target_position = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	self.action_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position - self.character.Position).normalized
	if vector_util.to_direction(self.action_direction) == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		self.action_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		--CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.action_direction)

		--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare')
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('action')

		-- 점프 처리
		self.character.SpineController:Jump(self.jump_height, self.action_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('post')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('impact', self.character.Position)

		-- 후처리 sfx
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 평면 이동
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.action_duration)
		local diff = vector_util.lerp(self.base_position, self.target_position, progress) - self.character.Position

		if not diff:IsAlmostZero() then
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.character, diff)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction
				if knock_direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = self.action_direction
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_radius = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('LaboseMonsterGuardBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 스턴 방어 세팅
	self.cs_action.StunDefense = stun_constants.factor_normal_strong
	--- 넉백 방어 세팅
	self.cs_action.KnockBackDefense = knock_back_constants.factor_normal_strong

	--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end
	--- 데미지 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param)
end

--- dispose state
function action_state_class:dispose()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.left
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 격겜이라 오른쪽만 본다.
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 공격 애니메이션
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info.name)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
end

function action_state_class:on_damage_event(e)
	--- 스킬 미 작동중이면 패스
	if self.cs_action.IsActive == false then return end

	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = e.Info

	--- 내가 보낸 데미지도 무시
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(damage_info.sender, self.owner) then return end

	--- 데미지 타겟이 내가 아니라면 무시
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(damage_info.target, self.owner) then return end
end

--- 종료하는 함수
function action_state_class:end_state()
	self.machine:change(nil)

	--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end
--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.action_state:dispose()
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.state_machine = nil
		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	return self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	if self:is_available() == false then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 정보 싱크
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 스테이트 변경
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	--- 액션이 활성화되어 있는 경우
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	return
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
