local local_class = newclass('LaboseMonsterNormalAttackBattleAction')

--x축 이동만 가능한 머니샷패턴
--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.8)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.8)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.action_delay_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDelayDuration", 0)

	self.damage = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Damage", 1)
	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 1)
	self.attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDelay", 0.1)
	self.stun_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "StunDuration", 0.5)
	self.knock_back_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackDistance')
	self.knock_back_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackDuration')
	self.hit_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'HitHeight', 12)
	self.dash_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DashDistance', 0)

	self.attack_position_offset = CS.Utils.GetVector3FromDictionary(params, "AttackOffset", unity_class.vector3(-4.33, 14.16, 0))
	self.effect_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "EffectDelay", 0.1)
	self.effect_position_offset = CS.Utils.GetVector3FromDictionary(params, "EffectOffset", unity_class.vector3(-3, 10, 0))
	self.is_flip_effect = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "IsFlipEffect", false)
	self.is_range_attack = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "RangeAttack", false)

	self.is_super_armor = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsSuperArmor', false)
	self.super_armor_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SuperArmorDuration', 1)
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params)

	self.ready_effect_delay_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ReadyEffectDelay', 0.5)
	self.ready_effect_position_offset = CS.Utils.GetVector3FromDictionary(params, "ReadyffectOffset", unity_class.vector3(-3, 10, 0))

	self.is_range_attack = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsRangeAttack', false)

	local size = CS.Utils.GetVector3FromDictionary(params, "BoundsSize", unity_class.vector3(2, 2, 1))

	-- 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = self.damage_term
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.Extents = size
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, self.attack_delay, 1)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		action_dealy = 2,
		prepare = 3,
		action = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
			self.cs_battle_action, params
	)

	self.target = nil
	self.is_start_effect = false
	self.effect = nil

	self.is_jump_active = false
	self.is_start_super_armor = false
	self.super_armor_time_passed = 0
	self.ready_effect_time_passed = 0
	self.is_start_prepare = false

	--- 스파인 이벤트 콜백 처리 함수
	self.on_spine_event_func = function(entry, event) self:on_spine_event(entry, event) end

	--- 스켈레톤 애니메이션 할당
	self.skeleton_animation = spine_util.get_skeleton_animation(self.character)
	--- 스파인 이벤트 콜백 할당
	self.skeleton_animation.state:Event('+', self.on_spine_event_func)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	self.magnitude = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ShakeMagnitude')
	self.shake_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ShakeDuration')
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	if self.effect ~= nil then
		self.effect:Dispose()
		self.effect = nil
	end

	self.is_start_prepare = false
	self.super_armor_time_passed = 0
	self.ready_effect_time_passed = 0

	if self.is_super_armor then
		self.is_start_super_armor = true
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.character, self.character, self.buff_info)
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.action_delay)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.effect ~= nil then
		self.effect:Dispose()
		self.effect = nil
	end

	if self.is_super_armor then
		self.is_start_super_armor = false
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.character, self.character, self.buff_info.name)
	end

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.action_delay then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.action_delay then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.is_start_prepare = true
		self.attack_start_pos = self.character.Position
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self, 'prepare')
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		if not self.is_range_attack then
			battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self, 'action')
		end

		self.is_start_effect = false

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Bounds.center + self.attack_position_offset
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		if self.is_super_armor then
			self.is_start_super_armor = false
			buff_util.remove_buff(self.character, self.character, self.buff_info.name)
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:start_effect()
	self.effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action",
			self.character.Position + self.effect_position_offset)
	if self.is_flip_effect then
		self.effect.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
		self.effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 180)
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if self.is_start_prepare then
		if self.ready_effect_time_passed > self.ready_effect_delay_duration then
			self.effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("ready",
					self.character.Position + self.effect_position_offset)
			self.is_start_prepare = false
		else
			self.ready_effect_time_passed = self.ready_effect_time_passed + dt
		end
	end

	if self.is_start_super_armor then
		if self.super_armor_time_passed > self.super_armor_duration then
			if self.is_super_armor then
				self.is_start_super_armor = false
				self.super_armor_time_passed = 0
				buff_util.remove_buff(self.character, self.character, self.buff_info.name)
			end
		else
			self.super_armor_time_passed = self.super_armor_time_passed + dt
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.action_delay then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_delay_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.effect_delay and not self.is_start_effect then
				self.is_start_effect = true
				self:start_effect()
			end

			if self.dash_distance > 0 then
				local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.action_duration)
				local movement = progress - self.time_passed
				local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
				local dir = unity_class.vector3.left
				move_info.direction = dir
				move_info.magnitude = self.dash_distance * movement

				if not float_util.is_almost_zero(dt) then
					local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(dir), false)
					message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
				end
			end

			self:update_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end

end

		{
			'shake',
			tostring(magnitude),
			tostring(duration)
		}
	)
	message_system:SendSync(target, custom_event)
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	if not self.attack_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
	end
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

	if objects.Count > 0 then
		local first_target = objects[0]

		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]
			local send_shake = first_target == fo

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

				fo.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
				local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
				damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.damage = self.damage
				damage_info.direction = direction

				command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

				local attack_type = self.is_range_attack and CS.Oak.MoneyShotAttackTag.LightAttack or CS.Oak.MoneyShotAttackTag.NormalAttack
				local custom_event = CS.Oak.MoneyShotEvent.Create(
					self.character,
					CS.Oak.MoneyShotEventType.Damage,
					attack_type,
					self.damage,
					self.stun_duration,
					self.knock_back_distance,
					self.knock_back_duration,
					self.hit_height,
					send_shake and self.magnitude or 0,
					send_shake and self.shake_duration or 0
				)
				message_system:Send(fo, custom_event)
			end
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_spine_event(entry, event)
	--- 콜백 검증
	if spine_util.is_variable_callback(self.cs_battle_action, entry, spine_animation_track.base, 'attack_range') then

		--- 이벤트 키 검증

			battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self, 'action')
			return
		end
	end

function local_class:dispose()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	self.skeleton_animation.state:Event('-', self.on_spine_event_func)
	--- 스켈레톤 애니메이션 할당 해제

end

return {

		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.jump_time_passed = 0
	self.jump_start_pos = nil
	self.is_start_prepare = false

	self.super_armor_time_passed = 0
	self.ready_effect_time_passed = 0

	if self.is_super_armor then
		self.is_start_super_armor = true
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.character, self.character, self.buff_info)
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.action_delay)

function local_class:cancel()

	if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
	end

	if self.is_super_armor then
		self.is_start_super_armor = false
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.character, self.character, self.buff_info.name)
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.action_delay then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.action_delay then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.is_start_prepare = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position + self.attack_position_offset
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.is_start_prepare then

		if self.super_armor_time_passed > self.super_armor_duration then
			if self.is_super_armor then
				self.is_start_super_armor = false
				self.super_armor_time_passed = 0
				buff_util.remove_buff(self.character, self.character, self.buff_info.name)

		else

		end
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.action_delay then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_delay_duration then

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then

		else

		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then

		end
	end

			self.target = e.Target
			self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			--타겟표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 변경된 타겟을 보내 줌
			if self.show_target_arrow then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.laser_range
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

--- 최초 트리거 시점에 대상 갱신
function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.synced = false
	self.target = target
	self.is_target_seach = false

	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.show_target_arrow and target or nil)

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	if self.laser_effect ~= nil then
		self.laser_effect:Dispose()
		self.laser_effect = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.attack_calculator ~= nil then
			self.attack_calculator:End()
		end

		if self.laser_effect ~= nil then
			self.laser_effect:Dispose()
			self.laser_effect = nil
		end

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		self.character_direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.is_target_seach = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("action", self.character.Position)
		self.laser_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("laser", self.character.Position)
		local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
				unity_class.vector3.left, vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_dir)).eulerAngles.y
		self.laser_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	local old_time = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.tracking_duration then
				self:update_attack_range(dt)
				self:set_character_diration()
			elseif not self.synced and CS.Oak.PlayerExtensions.IsLocal(self.character.Owner) then
				self.synced = true
				self:sync_target_dir()
				self:set_character_diration()
			elseif self.synced and self.synced_target_dir ~= nil then
				if self.target_dir ~= nil and self.synced_target_dir ~= nil and self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
					self:update_sync_dir(dt)
					self:set_character_diration()
				end
			end

			if self.show_target_arrow and self.time_passed > self.target_search_duration and self.is_target_seach then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
				self.is_target_seach = false
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_damage(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync_target_dir()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 5)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.target_dir)
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0))

	--호스트의 마지막 TargetDir에 맞춰서 싱크
	if idx == 5 then
		self.synced_target_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		--현재 로컬의 target_dir이 sync로 날라온 dir과 다르다면 자연스럽게 이동시켜준다.
		if self.target_dir ~= self.synced_target_dir then
			self.synced_dir_move_speed = 15
		end
	end

	if idx == 9 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.is_critical_attack = true
	end
end

function local_class:update_sync_dir(dt)
	local diff = math.abs((self.synced_target_dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.1 then
		local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - self.synced_target_dir).normalized * dt * self.synced_dir_move_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = move_dir
	else
		self.target_dir = self.synced_target_dir
	end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
			local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
			local xz_move_direction = self.target_dir:GetXz().normalized
			local knock_direction
			if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.target_dir
			else
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.target_dir
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = self.target_dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:set_character_diration()
	--케스팅시간동안 캐릭터 방향 수정
	local new_direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)
	if self.character_direction ~= new_direction then
		self.character_direction = new_direction
		if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
			self.casting_effect.transform.position = self.character.Position + self:get_shot_effect_offset(self.character_direction)
		end
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character_direction)
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	if dir.magnitude <= 0.05 then
		dir = direction_util.to_vector3(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.GetLookDirection(self.character))
	end

	local diff = math.abs((dir - self.target_dir).magnitude)
	if diff > 0.05 then
		--local move_dir = (self.target_dir - ((self.target_dir - dir).normalized * dt * self.tracking_speed)).normalized
		self.target_dir = dir
	end

	self.target_dir = dir
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_dir)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.character_direction = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('LeftAloneStoneFallBattleAction')

local stone = {
	fx = nil,
	virtual_fo = nil,
	attack_range = nil,
	attack_calculator = nil,
	state = {
		none = 0,
		prepare = 1,
		fall = 2,
		fallen = 3,
		knock_back = 4,
	},
	stone_list = {},
	target_pos = nil,
	owner_character = nil,
	attack_radius = nil,
	attack_modifier = nil,
	knock_back_force = nil,
	zone_bound = nil,
	rock_hp = 10,
	on_destroy = nil,
	--자신이 넉백되는 방향
	knock_back_direction = nil,
	knock_back_speed = 0,
	last_id = 0,
	id = 0,
	shoot_helper = nil,
	cs_battle_action = nil,
	generated_cnt = 0,
	max_cnt = nil
}

function stone:new(battle_action)
	local new_stone = {}
	setmetatable(new_stone, { __index =  stone})

	stone.last_id = stone.last_id + 1
	new_stone.id = stone.last_id

	new_stone.shoot_helper = battle_action.shoot_helper
	new_stone.prepare_duration = battle_action.prepare_duration
	new_stone.attack_duration = battle_action.attack_duration

	new_stone.start_height = 10
	new_stone.fall_speed = new_stone.start_height / new_stone.attack_duration

	new_stone.cs_battle_action = battle_action.cs_battle_action
	new_stone.fx = battle_action.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(battle_action.stone_key, vector_util.zero)
	new_stone.fx.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	new_stone.attack_radius = battle_action.attack_radius
	new_stone.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, battle_action.attack_radius)
	new_stone.attack_range:Hide()

	new_stone.virtual_fo = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	new_stone.virtual_fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(battle_action.attack_radius, 2, battle_action.attack_radius) / 1.414)
	new_stone.virtual_fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EventWallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	new_stone.virtual_fo.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.FieldObjectConstantDamagedBehaviour()
	new_stone.virtual_fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.HittableObstacle
	new_stone.virtual_fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	new_stone.knock_back_speed = battle_action.stone_knock_back_speed

	new_stone.rock_hp = battle_action.rock_hp

	local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
			battle_action.attack_radius, 2, 1, -1, nil, true
	)
	new_stone.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(battle_action.character, info, true)
	new_stone.time_passed = 0

	new_stone.owner_character = battle_action.character
	new_stone.attack_modifier = battle_action.attack_modifier
	new_stone.knock_back_force = battle_action.knock_back_force
	new_stone.zone_bound = battle_action.battle_zone

	new_stone.current_state = self.state.none

	--낙석에 의한 넉백에 파괴되지 않도록
	new_stone.box_activate_time = 0.2

	new_stone.on_destroy = function(e)
		if new_stone.virtual_fo == e.FieldObject or e.FieldObject == new_stone.owner_character then
			new_stone.virtual_fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:RemoveAllDebuffs(new_stone.owner_character)
			new_stone.virtual_fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:RemoveAllBuffs(new_stone.owner_character)
			new_stone:change_state(stone.state.none)
			stone.generated_cnt = stone.generated_cnt - 1
			new_stone.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('break')
		end
	end

	new_stone.on_collision = function(e)
		if e.Crash.self ~= new_stone.virtual_fo then
			return
		end

		if new_stone.current_state == new_stone.state.knock_back or
				lua_helper.type_compare(e.Crash.other.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState) then
			new_stone:destroy()
		end
	end

	new_stone.on_damage = function(e)
		if e.Info.target == new_stone.virtual_fo and e.Info.sender == new_stone.owner_character and e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Death then
			new_stone:destroy()
		end
	end

	table.insert(stone.stone_list, new_stone)

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), new_stone.on_destroy)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent), new_stone.on_collision)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), new_stone.on_damage)

	return new_stone
end

function stone:destroy()
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self:shoot_fragments()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent.Create(self.virtual_fo, self.virtual_fo.Position, self.virtual_fo.Hitbox))
end

function stone:shoot_fragments()
	self:attack_target()
	self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(
			self.virtual_fo.Position + vector(0, 0.35, 0),	vector_util.back, 0, -1, nil, false)
end

function stone:fall()
	self.target_pos = self:get_target_pos_by_enemy_pos()

	if self.target_pos == nil then
		self.target_pos = self:get_random_target_pos()
	end

	if self.target_pos == nil then
		return
	end
	self.fx.transform.position = self.target_pos + vector_util.up * self.start_height + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5)
	self.virtual_fo.Position = self.target_pos

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function stone:get_target_pos_by_enemy_pos()
	--캐릭터 위치 기반으로 먼저
	local ret = nil
	local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.owner_character)
	if targets ~= nil then
		for i = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
			if self:check_target_available(targets[i].Position) then
				ret = targets[i].Position
				break
			end
		end
		targets:Dispose()
	end
	return ret
end

function stone:get_random_target_pos()
	local found = false
	local ret

	local left_margin = math.ceil(self.zone_bound.center.x - self.zone_bound.extents.x) + 2
	local right_margin = math.floor(self.zone_bound.center.x + self.zone_bound.extents.x) - 2
	local up_margin = math.ceil(self.zone_bound.center.z - self.zone_bound.extents.z) + 2
	local down_margin = math.floor(self.zone_bound.center.z + self.zone_bound.extents.z) - 2

	--없다면 랜덤
	while not found do
		ret = vector(random_util.get_random_int(left_margin, right_margin), 0,
				random_util.get_random_int(up_margin, down_margin))
		found = self:check_target_available(ret)
	end
	ret.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(ret):GetHeightAt(ret)

	return ret
end

function stone:check_target_available(target_pos)
	for i = 1, #self.stone_list do
		if vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(self.stone_list[i].virtual_fo.Position), target_pos) < self.attack_radius * 2
				or vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(self.owner_character.Position), target_pos) < self.attack_radius * 2 then
			return false
		end

	return true
end

function stone:change_state(next_state)

	end

function stone:attack_target()

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		if self.time_passed > self.attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fallen)
			return
		end

		self.fx.transform.position = self.fx.transform.position + vector_util.down * self.fall_speed * dt
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fallen then
		if self.time_passed > self.box_activate_time and self.virtual_fo.ActiveState & CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
			self:activate_virtual_fo()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.knock_back then
		self:update_knock_back(dt)
	end
end

function stone:update_knock_back(dt)
	local move_vector = self.knock_back_direction * (self.knock_back_speed * dt)
	local list = field:GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.virtual_fo.Bounds, move_vector)
	local fo_list = list.Values;
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count-1 do
		if fo_list[i] ~= self.virtual_fo then
			self:destroy()
			list:Dispose()
			return
		end
	end
	list:Dispose()

	self.virtual_fo.Position = self.virtual_fo.Position + move_vector
	self.fx.transform.position = self.fx.transform.position + move_vector
end

function stone:dispose()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.fx:Dispose()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_destroy)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent), self.on_collision)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage)
end

function stone:dispose_all()
	for i = #stone.stone_list, 1, -1 do
		stone.stone_list[i]:dispose()
		table.remove(stone.stone_list, i)
	end
	stone.stone_list = nil
end

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	local shooter = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'Projectile', 'demon_rock_piece')
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec(proj_name)
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			shooter, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	self.battle_zone = nil

	self.prepare_key = 'prepare'
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 2)

	self.stone_key = 'stone'

	self.stone_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'StoneCount', 4)
	stone.max_cnt = self.stone_count
	self.attack_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackModifier', 1)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1)
	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackRadius', 2)
	self.attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackDuration', 0.5)

	self.stone_knock_back_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SelfKnockBackSpeed', 10)

	self.rock_hp = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'RockHp', 20)

	self.fragment_key = 'fragment'

	self.on_custom_stage_event = function(e)
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'rock_fall' then
			if #stone.stone_list == 0 then
				for i = 1, self.stone_count do
					local fall_stone = stone:new(self)
					fall_stone:fall()
				end
			else
				for i = 1, #stone.stone_list do
					if stone.stone_list[i].current_state == stone.state.none then
						stone.stone_list[i]:fall()
					end
				end
			end
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'rock_break' then
			local target_id = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
			local target
			for i = 1, #stone.stone_list do
				if stone.stone_list[i].id == target_id then
					target = stone.stone_list[i]
				end

			target.virtual_fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:RemoveAllDebuffs(target.owner_character)
			target.virtual_fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:RemoveAllBuffs(target.owner_character)
			target:change_state(stone.state.knock_back)
			target.knock_back_direction = direction
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'rock_break_all' then
			for i = 1, #stone.stone_list do
					stone.stone_list[i]:destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event)

local local_class = newclass('LuaBossHarvesterBounceBallBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.state = {
		prepare = 1,
		shoot = 2
	}

	self.prepare_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(parameters, "PrepareTime", 0)
	self.firing_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(parameters, "FiringTime", 0.4)
	self.bullet_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(parameters, "BulletAmount", 6)
	self.shoot_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(parameters, "ShootTiming", 0)

	self.shoot_timing = math.min(self.firing_time, self.shoot_timing)

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
	local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "Projectile", "harvester_bounce_ball")
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec(proj_name)
	local pattern_info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
	pattern_info.columns = 1
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)

	self.sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	self.sfx_info.sfxName = "02_harvester_shoot_01"
	self.sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.BattleAttack
	self.sfx_info.playerPriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Boss

	music_player:PreloadSfx("02_harvester_shoot_01")

	self.remove_projectile = {}
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.shoot_helper:IsHittable(target)
end

function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd);

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	if self.prepare_time <= 0 then
		self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
	else
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state()
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.prepare_time > 0 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.shoot = nil
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.prepare_time > 0 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_time))
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shoot = false
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if #self.remove_projectile > 0 then
		for k,v in pairs(self.remove_projectile) do
			v:Deactive()
			table.remove(self.remove_projectile, k)
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if not self.shoot then
			if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_timing then
				self.shoot = true

				music_player:PlaySfx(self.sfx_info)

				local circle_shoot_spread_angle = 360 / self.bullet_amount
				for i = 0, self.bullet_amount - 1 do
					local rot_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(i * circle_shoot_spread_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * unity_class.vector3.back
					self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(self.character.Position + unity_class.vector3(0, 0.35, 0), rot_dir.normalized)
				end
			end
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.firing_time then
			self:change_state()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper == nil then return true end

	self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	local projectile = self.shoot_helper:GetProjectile(label)
	table.insert(self.remove_projectile, projectile)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	--return bool
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 신규 수속성 탱커 (adela_noble) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualAdelaNobleBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,

	--- 액션 유형 목록
	action_type = nil,
	--- 현재 액션 유형
	attack_type = nil,

	--- 히트 횟수
	max_hit = 0,

	--- 공격 타이밍
	attack_timing = 0,

	--- 공격 별 넉백 계수
	knock_back_multiplier = 1,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 전체 액션 타입
	self.action_type = {
		shieldbash = 1,
		stinger = 2,
		slash = 3,
		leap_attack = 4,
	}

	--- 이 액션의 유형 키
	local attack_type_key = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	--- 이 액션의 유형
	self.attack_type = self.action_type[attack_type_key]

	--- 넉백 계수
	self.knock_back_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockBackMultiplier')

	--- 히트 횟수
	self.max_hit = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxHit')

	--- 판정 높이
	local bound_height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash then
		--- 1타 방패 배쉬
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 지속시간
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')

		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 속도
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 지속시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		--- 판정 범위
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, bound_height, attack_duration)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

		--- 기본 히트이펙트 로드
		CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect:Preload()

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		--- 2타 찌르기
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 지속시간
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
		--- 판정 텀
		local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')

		--- 충돌체 폭
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
		--- 충돌체 길이
		local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- 충돌체 크기
		local collision_size = vector(length, bound_height, width)
		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(collision_size, attack_duration, damage_term, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 속도
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 지속시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + length * 0.5 * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

		--- 기본 히트이펙트 로드
		CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect:Preload()

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash  then
		--- 3타 슬래시
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 지속시간
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')

		--- 판정 각도
		local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')
		--- 판정 범위
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, bound_height, attack_duration)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 속도
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 지속시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

		--- 기본 히트이펙트 로드
		CS.Oak.BasicSwordHitEffect:Preload()
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.leap_attack then

		--print('adela noble 4th ready')
		--- 4타 내려찍기

		--- 판정 타이밍
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 길이
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')

		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 속도
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 지속시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		--- 오프셋, 캐릭터 바라보는 방향으로 n만큼 떨어진 거리로 좌표를 보정할떄 사용
		self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')

		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
			radius, bound_height, attack_duration, nil, nil, true
		)
		--- 원기둥 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(
			self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, 1
		)

		self.slash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SlashTiming')

		--- 공격 연출에서 판정 범위의 위치를 방향값에 맞추어 이동시키는 파라메터
		self.calc_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CalcOffset')

		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist + self.offset + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

		--- 기본 히트이펙트 로드
		CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect:Preload()
	end

end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()

	--- 각 공격 타입별로 로드한 히트이펙트가 달라 분기처리
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash
		or self.attack_type == self.action_type.leap_attack then
		return CS.Oak.BasicSwordHitEffect.IsLoaded

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash
		or self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		return CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect.IsLoaded
	end

	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.leap_attack then
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'cast',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			nil,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

	end

end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	if nil ~= self.fx_dash then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_dash)
		self.fx_dash = nil
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 공격 구현부

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.shieldbash then
		self:update_shieldbash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.stinger then
		self:update_stinger(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		self:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.leap_attack then
		self:update_leap_attack(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end

end

function action_state_class:update_shieldbash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 대시 직전 타겟, 방향 고정
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'dash',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'dash')

	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then

		local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
		--- 오른쪽,아래면 정방향으로 출력
		local key = (direction == direction_util.right or direction == direction_util.down) and 'slash' or 'slash_rev'

		--- 공격 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			key,
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.12)

		--- 판정 체크
		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)
			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end
		end
	end

end

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, attack_pos + self.dir_vector * self.calc_offset, self.dir_vector)

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	local hit_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, t)

	--- 데미지 방향
	damage_info.direction = hit_dir

	damage_info.hit_effect = damage_info_util.create_unity_object_hit_effect(
		self.action, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(t), nil, parent_follow_flag.none
	)

	--- 넉백 정보 입력
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_melee_knock_back(damage_info,
		knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force * self.knock_back_multiplier,
		knock_back_constants.factor_normal
	)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할때
	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()

	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		elseif state.finished_time_passed == 0 then
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish

--- 풍요의 신수 메이릴(alpaca_girl) 일반 기술
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 대상틀 탐색할 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 현재 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = string.lower(cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackType'))
	--- 실제 공격 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')
	--- 발사 위치 세로 오프셋
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'Offset')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashDuration')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashSpeed')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'ShootTiming')
	--- 프로젝타일 슈터
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)

			none = {

				exit = function(next_state) end,
				update = function(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt) end
			},
			--- 일반 발사 상태
			action = {
				id = 2,

			}

	end

end

	do
		self.current_state = nil

		for key in pairs(self.state) do
			for inner_key in pairs(self.state[key]) do
				self.state[key][inner_key] = nil
			end

			self.state[key] = nil
		end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.current_state = new_state

	--- 지나간 시간 리셋

	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.current_state and self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id

--- @return boolean 제어 여부

	return self.attack_type == 'shoot'
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	if not battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		dash_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
	end

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		self.owner.Bounds,
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		dash_dist * dir_vector
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	if closest_object == nil then
		closest_object = target
	end

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(
		bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(self.owner.Bounds, closest_object.Bounds, dir_vector), dash_dist
	)

	local proj_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1]) * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= min_dist + proj_dist
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	self.cs_action.ComboTarget:SetTarget(nil)

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
	)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	if self.attack_type == 'shoot' then
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(
			info, battle_util.get_stick_direction(self.cs_action)
		)
	end

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	self.sync_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
	self.dash_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 1)

	self:change_state(self.state.action)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 스테이트가 돌아갈 필요가 없을때
	if self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.current_time_passed
	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state.update then
		self.current_state.update(self, old_time_passed, self.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.finished_time_passed = self.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.action_duration <= self.current_time_passed then
		self:state_end_routine()
	end
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine()
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if self.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self:change_state(self.state.none)

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region action state

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_action_state(_)
	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	if self.dash_duration > 0 and vector_util.magnitude(self.dash_dir_vector) > 0 then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'dash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dash_dir_vector)

		--- 대시 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, nil, self.dash_dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil, false, 0
		)
	else
		self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.5 * self.sync_dir_vector
		)

		self.charge_audio_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	end
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_action_state(_)
	if self.charge_audio_holder then
		sfx_util.fade_out(self.charge_audio_holder, 1)
	end

	if self.cast_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
		self.cast_fx = nil
	end

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if self.sync_target then
		self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector
		)
	end

	if self.cast_fx and old_time_passed < self.hit_timing[1] then
		effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.5 * self.sync_dir_vector)
	end

	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			if self.cast_fx then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
				self.cast_fx = nil
			end

			local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

			if self.offset then
				local offset_vector = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.sync_dir_vector

				shoot_pos = shoot_pos + self.offset[index] * vector_util.normalized(offset_vector)
			end

			--- 발사 이펙트 생성
			projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos + 0.5 * self.sync_dir_vector, self.sync_dir_vector)

			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, self.sync_dir_vector)

			stage_camera:Shake(0.04, 0.05)

			if self.attack_type == 'blast' then
				--- 랜덤 밸류
				local value = random_util.get_random_value() * 2

				if value < 1 then
					--- 재생할 보이스 선택
					local voice_type = value < 0.333 and
						CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack1 or
						value < 0.666 and CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack2 or CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack3

					---보이스 재생
					battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, voice_type)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 지속 시간 만료 이거나 피해를 줄 수 있는 오브젝트에 부딪혔을때
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction or
		battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then

		--- 폭발 요청
		self:on_explosion(hit_info.position, move_info.direction)

		--- 프로젝타일 만료
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 실제 폭발 범위 내의 대상 판정
function local_class:on_explosion(explosion_pos, direction)
	--- spec cache
	local spec = self.proj_spec[1]

	--- instantiate explosion fx and play explosion sfx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(spec, explosion_pos, direction)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
		explosion_pos, spec.ExplosionRadius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, vector_util.normalized(target.Position - explosion_pos))
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, dir_vector)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier, #self.hit_timing)
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_magic_hit_02')

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
