--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 바케네코 미케 (bakeneko) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualBakenekoBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- 액션 유형 목록
	action_type = nil,
	--- 이 액션의 유형
	attack_type = nil,

	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 속도
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 지속시간
	dash_duration = nil,

	--- 오프셋
	offset = nil,
	--- 공격 타이밍
	attack_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 히트 수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- 판정 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- 이전 프레임의 중심 위치
	last_bounds_center = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
	activate_special_option = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 버프 정보
	special_buff_info = nil,
	--- 첫타 판정 여부
	is_first_hit = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 액션 유형 목록
	self.action_type = {
		dash = 1,
		slash = 2,
		stomp = 3,
		extra = 4
	}
	--- 이 액션의 유형 키
	local attack_type_key = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	--- 이 액션의 유형
	self.attack_type = self.action_type[attack_type_key]

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 속도
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 지속시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 대시 곱연산
	self.dash_speed_multiplier = 1
	--- 판정 크기 곱연산
	self.size_multiplier = 1
	--- 여기서 미리 개화 옵션 계산
	self:apply_myth_option(param)

	self.dash_speed = self.dash_speed * self.dash_speed_multiplier

	--- 대시 거리
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 액션 유형 별 분기
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.dash then
		--- 판정 지속시간
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
		--- 히트 수 1로 고정
		self.max_hit = 1

		--- 오프셋
		self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
		--- 충돌체 폭
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width') * self.size_multiplier
		--- 충돌체 길이
		local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length') * self.size_multiplier

		--- 충돌체 크기
		local collision_size = vector(width, height, length)
		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(collision_size, attack_duration)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + self.offset + length * 0.5 * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash or self.attack_type == self.action_type.extra then
		--- 공격 타이밍
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 지속시간
		local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
		--- 히트 수 1로 고정
		self.max_hit = 1
		--- 반지름
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius') * self.size_multiplier
		--- 각
		local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')

		--- 중돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, height, attack_duration, -1)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.stomp then
		--- 판정 타이밍
		self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
		--- 히트 수 1로 고정
		self.max_hit = 1

		--- 오프셋
		self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
		--- 반지름
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius') * self.size_multiplier
		--- 중돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + self.offset + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	end

	self:apply_option(param)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')
	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
		self.activate_special_option = true
		--- 특수 능력 버프 정보
		self.special_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'ManualBuff')
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_myth_option(param)

	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	--- 대시 곱연산
	self.dash_speed_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'DashSpeedMultiplier')
	--- 판정 크기 곱연산
	self.size_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'ColliderSizeMultiplier')
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 특수능력이 발동된 경우에만 체크한다.
	self.is_first_hit = self.activate_special_option

	--- 고정 방향 설정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 강화 공격인 경우 보이스 풀력
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.extra then
		battle_util.play_voice_in_args(self.cs_action, nil, character_voice_type.attack_2, character_voice_type.attack_3)
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 이모션 해제
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 고정 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대시 시점까진 방향 갱싱
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then

		--- 대시 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)

		--- 대시 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'dash',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- 애니메이션 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'dash')
		--- 이모션 설정
		battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'dash')
		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'dash')

		if self.attack_type == self.action_type.stomp then
			character_util.jump(self.owner, 1, self.dash_duration, self.dash_duration * 0.6)
		end
	end

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.dash then
		self:update_dash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash or self.attack_type == self.action_type.extra then
		self:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.stomp then
		self:update_stomp(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end

	--- 판정 동작 중에는 판정 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)
			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end

			--- 첫타일 경우
			--- 특수능력 분기 처리는 이미 되있을테니 생략한다.
			if self.is_first_hit then
				--- 버프 부여
				buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.special_buff_info)
				--- 첫타 플래그 해제
				self.is_first_hit = nil
			end
		end

		--- 판정 종료될 상태라면 종료 처리
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_dash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 판정 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset)
		--- 판정 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 공격 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'attack',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)
		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.2)
	end

	--- 판정 동기화 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 판정 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset)
		--- 판정 방향 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 판정 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 판정 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 공격 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'attack',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)
		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')

		if self.attack_type ~= self.action_type.extra then
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.13)
		else
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.13, 0.2)
		end
	end

	--- 판정 갱신
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 판정 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 판정 방향 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_stomp(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- 판정 위치 계산
		local target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset

		--- 공격 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'attack', target_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--- 슽래시 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'slash', target_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.12)

		--- 판정 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, target_pos)
		--- 판정 방향 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 반환함
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 모디파이어 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end

			--- 첫타일 경우
			--- 특수능력 분기 처리는 이미 되있을테니 생략한다.
			if self.is_first_hit then
				--- 버프 부여
				buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.special_buff_info)
				--- 첫타 플래그 해제
				self.is_first_hit = nil
			end
		end
	end

end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지

--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()

	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할때
	if target then

	end

	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)

		return
	end

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		elseif state.finished_time_passed == 0 then

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

	--- 프로젝타일 슈터

	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)

	--- 충돌 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.explosion_radius, 1)
	--- 충돌체 판정기
	self.collision_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, collision_info)

	--- 싱크된 타겟
	self.sync_target = nil

	--- 싱크된 방향
	self.sync_dir_vector = nil

	--- 강제 캔슬
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	--- 'swing' 애니메이션 시작 하는 시점
	self.swing_anim_start_time = 0

	-- 실제 애니메이션 길이와 공을 날리는 타이밍을 계산해서 애니메이션 시작 시간을 구한다.
	if self.animation_info['swing'] then
		local scale = self.animation_info['swing'].timescale
		local name = self.animation_info['swing'].name
		local anim_duration = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(self.character.SpineController,
			name)
		local target_duration = anim_duration / scale

		-- 공을 날리는 타이밍 (0 ~ 1.0)
		local ratio = 0.47
		local swing_timing = target_duration * (1 - ratio)

		self.swing_anim_start_time = math.max(self.cast_time - swing_timing, 0)
	end

	--- 배틀 액션 state들
	self.state = {
		none = {
			id = 1,
			enter = function(prev_state) end,
			exit = function(next_state) end,
			update = function(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt) end
		},
		swing = {

	self.current_state = self.state.none

	self.current_time_passed = 0

	if self.is_force_canceled then return end

	-- 방향이 있으면 발사하는 싱크
	if trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		local shoot_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

		if trigger_info_util.contains_target(info) then
			local shoot_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)

			if shoot_target and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, shoot_target) then

		self.sync_dir_vector)

	-- 처음에 멈춰있는 애니메이션 실행.
	-- swing 애니메이션 시작하기 전까지만 멈춰 있음
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'ready')

	-- 캐스팅하는 이펙트 실행
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', self.character.Position, nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.character))

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
end

function local_class:update_swing_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	if old_time_passed < self.swing_anim_start_time then
		self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.sync_target,
			self.sync_dir_vector)
	end

	-- 애니메이션 등은 여기서 미리 실행한다
	func_util.call_if(self.play_swing,
		battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.swing_anim_start_time), self)

	func_util.call_if(self.on_swing,
		battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.cast_time), self)

	-- 시간이 다 되면 다음 none으로 전환
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_action))
	end

	-- 애니메이션 및 Lock 제거

	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

--- 공을 날리는 이펙트 및 애니 등을 실행

	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'swing')
	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'swing')

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'slash', bounds_util.get_center(self.character),
		vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.sync_dir_vector), self.character.Transform)

	--- play slash sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'slash')
end

--- 실질적인 공을 날린다
function local_class:on_swing()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	if self.sync_target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.sync_target)
		self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.sync_target)
	end

	-- offset만큼 떨어져서 발사
	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.character) + self.sync_dir_vector * self.shoot_offset

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.sync_dir_vector)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, shoot_pos)

	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- 공의 타격 판정이 일어났을 때
function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	if self.is_force_canceled then return end

	-- 폭발 위치 싱크 보내고, 싱크하는 곳에서 폭발 작동시킴
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, hit_info.position)

	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- 공이 폭발할 때 데미지를 입힌다.
function local_class:on_explosion(pos)
	-- 폭발 이펙트 발생 및 충돌 계산기 돌림
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', pos)

	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'explosion', pos)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.065, 0.1)

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.collision_calculator, pos)
	area_collision_util.start(self.collision_calculator)

	local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.collision_calculator, 0)

	local dps = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)
	local target_exist = false

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
			local dir = (target.Position - pos).normalized
			self:on_damage(target, dps, dir)

			target_exist = true
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.collision_calculator)

	if target_exist then
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'hit', pos)
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'hit2', pos)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:on_damage(target, modifier, dir)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.direction = dir
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 윤 (blue_dragon) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualBlueDragonBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- attack modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,

	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 발사 오프셋
	offset = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- attack modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')

	local size = unity_class.vector3(length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, width)
	--- 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, nil, nil, true)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	self:apply_option(param)

	--- 싱크 유형
	self.sync_type = {
		--- 액션 시작
		start = 1,
		--- 타겟 변경
		change_target = 2,
		--- 완료
		finish = 3
	}

end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then break end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true
		else
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true

			--- 아군 치명타 배율 5초간 10% 5회중첩
			self.crit_buff = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param)
			--- 5회중첩시 추가 강화 버프
			self.extra_buff = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'ExtraBuff')

			local buff_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('BuffData'):GetBuffSpecFromName(self.crit_buff.name)
			self.max_stack = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(buff_spec.Data, 'StackCap')

			self.active_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ActiveCount')
			self.current_hit_count = 0
			self.cwp_dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DamageModifier')

			local elemental_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(option_param, 'Elemental')
			self.elemental_type = CS.Oak.ElementalTypeExtensions.GetFromString(elemental_name)
		end

	until true end
end

function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return distance <= self.hittable_dist
end

function action_state_class:sync(info, reset_force_cancel)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 대상이 존재했었는지 여부
	self.exist_target = trigger_info_util.contains_target(info)

	--- 루틴 시작한 경우 강제 캔슬 여부 리셋
	if reset_force_cancel then
		self.force_cancel = false
	end
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(prev_state)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- set anim
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 범위 공격 이펙트
	self.fx_cast = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast_loop', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset, self.dir_vector,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	--- 범위 공격 이펙트
	self.fx_laser = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'laser_loop', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset, self.dir_vector,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
	--- play loop sfx
	self.sfx_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'loop')
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'end')
	--- 범위 공격 이펙트 해제
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_cast)
	self.fx_cast = nil
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_laser)
	self.fx_laser = nil

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast_end', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset, self.dir_vector,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	--- 범위 공격 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'laser_end', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset, self.dir_vector,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- fade out loop sfx
	sfx_util.fade_out(self.sfx_holder, 0.2)
	self.sfx_holder = nil

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove upper animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 스태미나 사용
	continuous_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action, dt)

	local start_idx = math.floor(old_time_passed / self.action_duration) + 1
	local end_idx = math.floor(time_passed / self.action_duration)

	--- 대상이 유효한 상황
	if self.target then
		--- 대상, 대상 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 캐릭터 중심
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	--- IK 갱신
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)
	--- 이펙트 업데이트
	effect_util.update_object(self.fx_laser, center + self.dir_vector * self.offset, self.dir_vector)
	effect_util.update_object(self.fx_cast, center + self.dir_vector * self.offset, self.dir_vector)

	--- 네트웍 타겟 갱신 및 부쉬
	if self.exist_target and (not self.target or bush_util.is_hide(self.target)) then

		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
			self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
		)

		--- 싱크 정보 구성
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		if self.target then
			trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, self.target)
		else
			self.exist_target = false
		end

		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.dir_vector)

		trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, self.sync_type.change_target)

		--- 커맨드 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	for idx = start_idx, end_idx do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, idx * self.action_duration) then
			--- 사용이 가능한 상태
			if self.action.attacking and battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
				--- 공격이 가능한 상태 (네트워크 캐릭터가 아닐 경우)
				if battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) then
					--- 판정 세팅
					area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, center)
					area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

					area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

					--- 판정 처리
					local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)

					--- 판정 종료
					area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

					battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.1)

					--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 생략함
					if #hit_targets == 0 then break end


					if self.activate_cwp_option then
						--- [무기옵션] 적중 당 치명타 배율 5초 10% 5회 중첩
						self:apply_ally_buff()

						--- 카운트 증가
						self.current_hit_count = self.current_hit_count + 1

						if self.current_hit_count >= self.active_count then
							self.activate_option_damage = true
							self.current_hit_count = 0
							battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.12)
						end
					end

					local extra_hit_info = nil
					if self.activate_option_damage then
						extra_hit_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
						--- 구분용 플래그
						trigger_info_util.append_number(extra_hit_info, -1)
						trigger_info_util.append_direction(extra_hit_info, self.dir_vector)
					end

					--- 공격 배율
					local modifier = continuous_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(self.cs_action, self.action_duration)

					--- 데미지 부여
					for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
						self:apply_damage(target, modifier)

						--- [cwp] 9회 째 적중에 추가 피해
						if self.activate_option_damage then

							self:apply_option_damage(target)

							--- 종료 플래그 설정
							trigger_info_util.append_target(extra_hit_info, target)
						end
					end

					if extra_hit_info then
						--- 커맨드 배포
						command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, extra_hit_info)
					end

					self.activate_option_damage = false

				end

				--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
			else
				--- 트리거 정보 구성
				local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
				--- 종료 플래그 설정
				trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, self.sync_type.finish)
				--- 커맨드 배포
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')
	--- 9타라면 추가 피해 계산
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function action_state_class:sync_extra_hit_fx(info)
	--- 대상
	local extra_targets = trigger_info_util.get_targets(info)
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	if extra_targets == nil or #extra_targets <= 0 then return end

	for idx = 1, #extra_targets do
		local target = extra_targets[idx]
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cwp_hit', bounds_util.get_center(target), self.dir_vector)
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_option_damage(target)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action) | damage_source_type.cwp_option
	damage_info.modifier = character_util.get_atk_2_dps(self.owner) * self.cwp_dps_multiplier
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'extra_hit')

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function action_state_class:apply_ally_buff()
	--- 스테이지 멤버
	local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)

	--- 파티원 순회
	for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
		--- 사망 여부 체크
		if character_util.is_dead(member) then break end

		--- 오너의 속성과 다르다면 제외
		if character_util.get_elemental_type(member) ~= self.elemental_type then break end
		--- 버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, member, self.crit_buff)

		for _, buff in pairs(character_util.get_active_buffs(member)) do
			--- 버프 이름 체크
			if buff.BuffSpec.Name == self.crit_buff.name then
				--- 풀 스탯 체크
				if buff_util.get_buff_stack(buff) >= self.max_stack then
					--- 무기 옵션 버프 적용
					buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, member, self.extra_buff)

				end
			end
		end

	until true end
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 스테이트 클래스
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)

	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.state_machine and not self.state_machine:is_nil_state() and self.state_machine.state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and
			battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then

			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 히트 카운트 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action_state.hit_count)

	--- 평타 시작 상태
	trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.action_state.sync_type.start)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트가 유효할때만 처리한다.
	if not self.action_state then return end

	if trigger_info_util.contains_number(info) then
		self.action_state:sync_extra_hit_fx(info)
		return
	end

	--- 싱크 타입
	local sync_label = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	--- 액션 시작
	if sync_label == self.action_state.sync_type.start then
		self.action_state:sync(info, true)
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)

		--- 타겟 변경
	elseif sync_label == self.action_state.sync_type.change_target then
		self.action_state:sync(info)

		--- 액션 종료
	elseif sync_label == self.action_state.sync_type.finish then
		--- state reset
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end
--endregion
return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 해변의 레이서 레이첼 (boatracing_girl) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualBoatracingGirlBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 전체 액션 타입
	self.action_type = {
		slash = 1,
		upper = 2,
		stomp = 3,
		shoot = 4,
	}

	--- max hit
	self.max_hit = 1

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 이 액션의 유형 키
	local attack_type_key = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	--- 이 액션의 유형
	self.attack_type = self.action_type[attack_type_key]

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then

		--- 공격 타이밍
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')

		--- 판정 범위
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 판정 각도
		local angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(radius, angle, height)
		--- 반달모양 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 속도
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 지속시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.upper then

		--- 공격 타이밍
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')

		--- 충돌체 폭
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
		--- 충돌체 길이
		local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')

		--- 충돌체 크기
		local collision_size = vector(length, height, width)
		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(collision_size, nil, nil, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 속도
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 지속시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.stomp then

		--- 공격 타이밍
		self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
		--- 판정 오프셋
		self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')

		--- 판정 범위
		local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		--- 대시 타이밍
		self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
		--- 대시 속도
		self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
		--- 대시 지속시간
		self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
		--- 대시 거리
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.shoot then

		--- 막타 시 부여할 디버프
		self.debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'Debuff')

		--- 투사체 발사 시간
		self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

		--- cs projectile shooter
		self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
		--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
		self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

		--- hitabble distance
		self.hittable_dist = self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	end

	--- 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)

	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do
		repeat
			--- 옵션 유효성 확인
			local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

			--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
			if activate_option == false then
				break
			end

			--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
			local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

			if is_special then
				--- 특수옵션 적용 시
				self.activate_special_option = true

				--- 반격 실패 버프 정보
				self.role_fail_buff_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(option_param, 'RoleFailBuffName')

				--- 롤액션 실패했을 때 증가할 평타 데미지
				self.role_damage_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DamageModifier')
			end
		until true
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return self.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

	--- set animation
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.upper then

		if (look_dir & direction_util.up) ~= direction_util.none and 0 <= self.dir_vector.x then
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack_back')
		elseif (look_dir & direction_util.down) ~= direction_util.none and self.dir_vector.x < 0 then
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack_back')
		else
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
		end

	else
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 공격 구현부
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		self:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.upper then
		self:update_upper(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.stomp then
		self:update_stomp(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.shoot then
		self:update_shoot(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end
end

--- 1타 : 베기
function action_state_class:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 대시 직전 타겟, 방향 고정
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 대시 요청
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, 0.15)

		--- attack 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'cast',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * 0.3,
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner),
			parent_follow_flag.position
		)

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(
			self.calculator,
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 피격 대상이 있다면
		if 0 < #fo_list then
			--- 액션 계수 계산
			local modifier = self:get_attack_modifier()

			--- 데미지 부여
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, true)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 2타 : 올려베기
function action_state_class:update_upper(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 대시 직전 타겟, 방향 고정
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 대시 요청
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.15)

		--- attack 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')

		--- 보는 좌우 방향에 따라 다른 cast 이펙트를 만들어준다.
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			self.dir_vector.x < 0 and 'cast_rev' or 'cast',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner),
			parent_follow_flag.position
		)

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(
			self.calculator,
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 피격 대상이 있다면
		if 0 < #fo_list then
			--- 액션 계수 계산
			local modifier = self:get_attack_modifier()

			--- 데미지 부여
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, true)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 3타 : 내려찍기
function action_state_class:update_stomp(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 대시 직전 타겟, 방향 고정
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 대시 요청
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then

		--- jump 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'jump')

		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, 0.18)

		--- attack 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')

		--- stomp effect
		local stomp_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + (self.dir_vector * self.offset)

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', stomp_pos)

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(
			self.calculator,
			stomp_pos
		)

		--- 피격 대상이 있다면
		if 0 < #fo_list then
			--- 액션 계수 계산
			local modifier = self:get_attack_modifier()

			--- 데미지 부여
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, true)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 4타 : 투사체 발사
function action_state_class:update_shoot(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 대시 직전 타겟, 방향 고정
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.15)

		--- 발사 위치
		local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector

		--- 투사체의 발사 vfx, sfx 생성
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)

		--- 투사체 발사
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
			self.shoot_helper[1],
			shoot_pos,
			self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 타겟이 존재하면 즉시 데미지를 줌.
		if self.target then
			--- 히트 이펙트
			projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec[1], bounds_util.get_center(self.target))

			--- 데미지 부여
			local modifier = self:get_attack_modifier()

			self:apply_damage(self.target, modifier, false)

			--- 디버프 적용
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.target, self.debuff_info)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)

	--- 지속시간 만료시엔 폭발 이펙트 임의로 출력
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_expire_fx(self.proj_spec[1], hit_info.position)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 데미지 계수 반환 함수. 롤액션 실패 버프를 고려해야 한다.
function action_state_class:get_attack_modifier()

	--- 데미지 부여
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

	--- 반격 실패버프 걸려있다면
	if self.activate_special_option and character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.role_fail_buff_name) then
		modifier = modifier * (1 + self.role_damage_modifier)

		--- 실패버프 해지
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.role_fail_buff_name)
	end

	return modifier
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, is_apply_stun)

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	if is_apply_stun then
		damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
		damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	end

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할때
	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not self.action_state then
		return true
	end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		elseif state.finished_time_passed == 0 then
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
