--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 크리스마스의 정령 캐럴(captain_rabbit) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualCaptainRabbitBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 공격 타입
	attack_type = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 판정 길이
	length = nil,
	--- 판정 폭
	width = nil,
	--- 판정 간격
	term = nil,
	--- 최대 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 딜레이
	hit_delay = nil,
	--- 최대 판정 거리
	max_dist = nil,
	--- 판정 반지름
	radius = nil,
	--- 판정 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 전용 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 생성된 찌르기 이펙트
	thrust_fx = nil,
	--- 발사체
	proj = {
		left_time = {},
		pos = {}
	}
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	if self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		--- 판정 길이
		self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- 판정 폭
		self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')

		--- 판정 크기
		local size = vector(self.length, height, self.width)

		--- 판정 간격
		self.term = 0.12
		--- 최대 판정 횟수
		self.max_hit = 2

		--- 판정 정보
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, nil, self.term, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

	elseif self.attack_type == 'continuous' then
		--- 판정 길이
		self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
		--- 판정 폭
		self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')

		--- 판정 크기
		local size = vector(self.length, height, self.width)

		--- 판정 간격
		self.term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')
		--- 최대 판정 횟수
		self.max_hit = 6

		--- 판정 정보
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, nil, self.term, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

	elseif self.attack_type == 'proj' then
		--- 발사 타이밍
		self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

		--- 판정 딜레이
		self.hit_delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitDelay')

		--- 최대 판정 거리
		self.max_dist = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxDist')
		--- 판정 반지름
		self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

		--- 판정 정보
		self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.radius)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)
	end

	--- 옵션 관련 데이터 가져옴
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- 옵션 데이터 파싱
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 되어있을때
	if activate_option then
		--- 전용 옵션 발동
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 적중시 감소할 재사용 시간
		self.reduce_cool_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ReduceCoolTime')
	end
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 대상 포지션 초기화
	self.target_pos = nil
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return self.attack_type ~= 'proj'
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	if self.attack_type == 'thrust' or self.attack_type == 'continuous' then
		--- 대상 방향
		local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

		--- extension cache
		local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
		local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

		local owner_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner)

		--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

		if not battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
			dash_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
		end

		--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
		local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
			owner_bounds,
			entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
			dash_dist * direction
		)

		--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
		if closest_object == nil then
			closest_object = target
		end

		local closest_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object)

		--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
		local min_dist = math.min(bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(owner_bounds, closest_bounds, direction), dash_dist)

		return distance <= min_dist + self.length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	elseif self.attack_type == 'proj' then
		return distance <= self.max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	end

	return true
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action upper animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- set action emotion
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 일반 공격 3 타
	if self.attack_type == 'proj' then
		--- 좌우로 방향을 고정
		local direction = self.dir_vector.x > 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		--- set locked direction
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, direction)
	end

	--- Role 액션 정보가 없을때
	if self.role_action == nil then
		--- 롤액션 탐색
		self.role_action = battle_util.get_role_action(self.owner)
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.attack_type == 'continuous' then
		--- 오디오 홀더 fade
		sfx_util.fade_out(self.thrust_audio_holder, 0.3)

		--- 액션이 캔슬되었을때
		if self.finished_time_passed == 0 then
			--- dispose thrust fx
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.thrust_fx, true)
		end
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기를 사용하는 경우에만 종료
	if self.calculator then
		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 오디오 홀더 비움
	self.thrust_audio_holder = nil
	--- 찌르기 이펙트 비움
	self.thrust_fx = nil
	--- 내부 체커 초기화
	self.last_hit = nil

	--- remove emotion
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 일반 공격 1타
	if self.attack_type == 'thrust' then
		--- 대시 이전까지
		if old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
			--- 대상 방향 갱신
			self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
		end

		--- 대시 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
			--- 대시 요청
			battle_util.melee_short_dash(
				self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
				0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
				CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, nil, 0
			)

			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.2)
		end
		self:thrust_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 일반 공격 2타
	elseif self.attack_type == 'continuous' then
		--- 타겟이 있는 동안 계속 방향 갱신
		if self.target then
			--- 대상 방향 갱신
			self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

			--- bounds center
			local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

			--- set ik
			spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)
		end

		--- 대시 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.04, 0.4)
		end

		--- 대시 이후 루틴
		if self.dash_timing < time_passed then
			--- 대시 거리를 구함
			local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * dt

			--- 타겟이 존재할때
			if self.target then
				local ray_dist = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(
					bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner), bounds_util.get_bounds(self.target), self.dir_vector
				)

				dash_dist = math.min(ray_dist, dash_dist)
			end

			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, self.dir_vector, dash_dist)
		end

		self:thrust_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	elseif self.attack_type == 'proj' then
		self:proj_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function action_state_class:thrust_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- set thrust animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'thrust')

		--- bounds center
		local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

		--- set ik
		spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)

		--- instantiate thrust effect
		self.thrust_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'thrust', center + 0.5 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector
		)

		--- play thrust sfx
		self.thrust_audio_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'thrust')

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 세팅
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, center)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 세팅
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 계산기 동작 중
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- modifier 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

		--- 판정 타겟
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 타겟 존재 여부
		local exist_target = false

		--- ifo list 순회
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)

			exist_target = true
		end

		--- 타겟이 존재할때
		if exist_target then
			if self.activate_cwp_option and (self.last_hit == nil or self.last_hit + self.term <= time_passed) then
				self.last_hit = time_passed

				CS.Oak.IRoleBattleActionExtensions.UpdateCooltime(self.role_action, self.reduce_cool_time)
			end
		end

		--- dispose pooled list
		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end

	if self.thrust_fx then
		effect_util.update_object(
			self.thrust_fx, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.5 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector
		)
	end
end

function action_state_class:proj_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 타겟이 있는 동안 계속 방향 갱신
	if old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing[#self.shoot_timing] then
		--- 타겟 검증
		if is_unity_null(self.target) or character_util.is_dead(self.target) then
			self.target = nil
		else
			self.dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target)
			--- 포지션 갱신
			self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
		end
	end

	for index = 1, #self.shoot_timing do repeat
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[index]) then
			local start_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)

			if self.target_pos == nil or vector_util.magnitude(self.target_pos - start_pos) > self.max_dist then
				self.target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(start_pos + self.max_dist * self.dir_vector)
			end

			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, self.dir_vector.x > 0 and 'proj' or 'projrev', self.target_pos)

			--- play proj sfx
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'proj')

			table.insert(self.proj.left_time, self.hit_delay)
			table.insert(self.proj.pos, self.target_pos)
		end
	until true end
end

function action_state_class:update_proj(dt)
	for index = #self.proj.left_time, 1, -1 do
		self.proj.left_time[index] = self.proj.left_time[index] - dt

		if self.proj.left_time[index] <= 0 then
			--- modifier 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
				self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, #self.shoot_timing
			)

			--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.proj.pos[index])
			--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- 판정 타겟
			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

			--- 타겟 존재 여부
			local exist_target = false

			--- ifo list 순회
			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)

				--- shake camera
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.06, 0.05)

				exist_target = true
			end

			--- 타겟이 존재할때
			if exist_target then
				CS.Oak.IRoleBattleActionExtensions.UpdateCooltime(self.role_action, self.reduce_cool_time)
			end

			--- dispose pooled list
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

			--- play explosion sfx
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

			table.remove(self.proj.left_time, index)
			table.remove(self.proj.pos, index)
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 히트 사운드가 존재할때
	if self.action.sfx_info['hit'] then
		--- 사운드 정보 추가
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)
	end

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true

	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner),
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		dash_dist * direction
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	if closest_object == nil then
		closest_object = target
	end

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local ray_dist = bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(
		bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner), bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), direction
	)
	local min_dist = math.min(ray_dist, dash_dist)
	local addtional_dist = self.radius * 0.8

	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= min_dist + addtional_dist
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션 캔슬
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- state update
	self:on_state_update(dt)

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- 내부 스테이트 업데이트
function local_class:on_state_update(dt)
	--- 스테이트가 돌아갈 필요가 없을때
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.current_time_passed
	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state.update then
		self.current_state.update(self, old_time_passed, self.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 스태미너 브레이크 인가?
	local break_attack = discrete_stamina_action_util.is_break_attack(self.cs_action)
	--- 현재 라벨
	local label = break_attack and self.atk_type.stamina_break or self.atk_type.default

	--- 역베기 일때 label 추가
	if self.is_reverse then label = label + 10 end

	--- 베기 플래그 교체
	self.is_reverse = not self.is_reverse

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range
	)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, dir_vector)

	--- 공격 타입 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, label)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 대상 Sync
	self.sync_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	--- 대상 방향 Sync
	self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
	--- 추가 정보 Sync
	local label = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)
	--- 현재 공격 타입
	local sync_label = label % 10
	--- 현재 공격 방향
	self.sync_reverse = label > 10

	if sync_label == self.atk_type.default then
		--- 현재 시퀸스 초기화
		self.current_sequence = 1
		--- state change
		self:change_state(self.state.slash)
	else
		--- 현재 시퀸스 초기화
		self.current_sequence = 3
		--- state change
		self:change_state(self.state.breakslash)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--region slash state

---
--- 아래 스테이트 부터 sequence라는 로컬 변수가 쓰임
--- 각 숫자가 의미하는 바는 아래와 같음
--- sequence == 1 : 180도 베기
--- sequence == 2 : 360도 베기
--- sequence == 3 : 360도 3연 베기
---
function local_class:enter_slash_state(_)
	local sequence = self.current_sequence

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- 상황에 맞는 키
	local key = (self.sync_reverse and 'reverse' or 'action') .. sequence
	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, key)

	--- play action sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'action' .. sequence)

	--- 180도 베기의 경우 대시를 함
	if sequence == 1 then
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector,
			self.stay_duration, self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil, nil, 0
		)

		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'run')

		--- 배틀액션 강제 컨트롤 플래그
		self.is_control = true

		--- 스태미나 사용
		discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)

	--- 3연 베기에 맞는 연출
	elseif sequence == 3 then
		--- set break emo
		battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'break')

		--- 스태미나 사용
		discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)
	end
end

function local_class:exit_slash_state(next_state)
	--- 배틀액션 강제 컨트롤 플래그 끔
	self.is_control = false

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- remove emo
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 다음 액션이 none 일때 (액션이 종료되었을때)
	if next_state and next_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		--- remove anim
		battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
		--- remove locked direction
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	end
end

--- 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_slash_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 현재 진행중인 시퀸스
	local sequence = self.current_sequence
	--- 현재 시퀸스에서 판정 시작 타이밍
	local hit_timing = self.hit_timing[sequence]
	--- 현재 시퀸스에서 판정 시간
	local attack_duration = self.attack_duration[sequence]
	--- 현재 시퀸스에서 판정이 끝나는 타이밍
	local end_timing = hit_timing + attack_duration

	--- 대시가 끝난 경우 처리
	if sequence == 1 and
		battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.stay_duration + self.dash_duration) then
		--- 배틀액션 강제 컨트롤 플래그 끔
		self.is_control = false
	end

	--- 실제로 판정을 시작하는 타이밍 직전에 관련 애니메이션을 재생하고 이펙트를 생성
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, math.max(hit_timing - 0.02, 0)) then
		--- 상황에 맞는 키
		local key = (self.sync_reverse and 'rslash' or 'slash') .. sequence

		local dir_vector = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.sync_dir_vector)
		local direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector)

		if sequence == 2 then
			local current_angle = self.angle[sequence - 1] / 2

			if not self.sync_reverse and (direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up or direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left) or
				self.sync_reverse and (direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down or direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right) then
				current_angle = -current_angle
			end

			dir_vector = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, current_angle, 0) * dir_vector
		end

		--- instantiate slash fx
		local slash = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, key, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.2 * self.sync_dir_vector,
			dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		if sequence == 2 then
			if self.sync_reverse and (direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up or direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right) or
				not self.sync_reverse and (direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down or direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left)then
				slash.transform.localRotation = slash.transform.localRotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 180)
			end
		end

		--- play slash sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'slash' .. sequence)

		stage_camera:Shake(0.04, 0.05)
	end

	--- 판정 진행중
	if hit_timing <= time_passed and old_time_passed < end_timing then
		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- 판정이 정확히 시작하는 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, hit_timing) then
			--- 충돌체 정보 갱신
			area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.sync_dir_vector))
			self.collision_info.Angle = self.angle[sequence]

			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
		end

		--- pie 형태 판정
		if sequence == 2 then
			local dir_vector_4way = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.sync_dir_vector)
			local direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector_4way)

			local last_seq_angle = self.angle[sequence - 1] / 2
			local total_angle = self.angle[sequence]

			local old_angle = (math.max(old_time_passed, hit_timing) - hit_timing) / attack_duration * total_angle + last_seq_angle
			local angle = (math.min(time_passed, end_timing) - hit_timing) / attack_duration * total_angle + last_seq_angle

			local center_angle = (old_angle + angle) / 2

			if not self.sync_reverse and (direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up or direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left) or
				self.sync_reverse and (direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down or direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right) then
				center_angle = -center_angle
			end

			local center_dir_vector = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, center_angle, 0) * dir_vector_4way

			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
			area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, center_dir_vector)
			self.collision_info.Angle = math.abs(angle - old_angle)
		end

		--- 데미지 계수
		local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
			self.cs_action, self.action_duration,
			self.modifier_scale.stamina_break - self.modifier_scale.default
		)

		modifier = modifier / #self.state_duration

		--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
				self:apply_damage(target, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), modifier)
			end
		end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 판정이 끝나는 타이밍
		if end_timing <= time_passed then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 어택 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration[sequence]) then
		--- 시퀸스 증가
		self.current_sequence = sequence + 1

		--- 시퀸스가 있다면 스테이트를 다시 돌림
		if self.current_sequence <= #self.state_duration then
			--- 스테이트 교체
			self:change_state(self.state.slash)
		--- 시퀸스가 없다면 상태 종료
		else
			--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
			if self.attacking and
				battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
				battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
				--- 액션을 사용
				self:on_action_available()
				--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
			else
				--- 스테이트 리셋
				self:change_state(self.state.none)

				--- 배틀액션 비활성화
				self.cs_action.IsActive = false

				--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
			end
		end
	end
end

--endregion

--region breakslash state

--- 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_breakslash_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 현재 진행중인 시퀸스
	local sequence = self.current_sequence

	for index = 1, #self.break_hit_timing do
		--- 체크할 판정 타이밍
		local hit_timing = self.break_hit_timing[index]

		--- 실제로 판정을 시작하는 타이밍 직전에 관련 애니메이션을 재생하고 이펙트를 생성
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, math.max(hit_timing - 0.02, 0)) then
			--- 상황에 맞는 키
			local key = (self.sync_reverse and 'rslash' or 'slash') .. sequence

			--- set slash anim
			battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action,key)

			--- instantiate slash fx
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self, key, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.2 * self.sync_dir_vector,
				unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_util.get_random_int(0, 360), 0) * vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.sync_dir_vector),
				spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
			)
		end

		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, hit_timing - 0.02) then
			--- 충돌체 정보 갱신
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
			area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.sync_dir_vector)
			self.collision_info.Angle = 360

			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
		end

		if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 정보 갱신
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

			--- 데미지 계수
			local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
				self.cs_action, self.action_duration,
				self.modifier_scale.stamina_break - self.modifier_scale.default
			)

			modifier = modifier * self.modifier_scale.stamina_break / #self.break_hit_timing

			--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, 0)

			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
					self:apply_damage(target, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), modifier)
				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()
		end

		if index ~= #self.break_hit_timing then
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.break_hit_timing[index + 1] - 0.02) then
				area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
			end
		else
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
				area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, position, modifier)
	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(
		vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(target) - position)
	)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 선산권사 (china_hero) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualChinaHeroBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state, ignore_reset_time)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		--- 동일한 상태일 경우 time_passed 초기화를 무시 가능
		local reset_time_passed = not ignore_reset_time or prev_state ~= self.state

		if self.state.current_time_passed and reset_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,

	--- 일반 공격 배율
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 강화 공격 배율
	enhance_atk_modifier = nil,
	--- num hits per sec
	hits_per_sec = nil,

	--- 판정 시작 시점 (매크로 방지 용으로, 코드에서 action_duration 기반으로 설정한다)
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 크기 비율
	scale_factor = nil,
	--- 판정 거리
	base_length = nil,
	--- 강화 확률
	enhance_probability = nil,
	--- 강화 인터벌
	enhance_interval = nil,
	--- visual only
	fx_offset = nil,

	--- 대시 속도
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- ai에 적용될 대시 속도
	dash_speed_for_ai = nil,
	--- 대시 지속 시간
	dash_duration = nil,

	--- 이펙트 프리셋 분기용
	use_alternative_key = nil,

	--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 강화 공격 회복 비율
	heal_modifier = nil,

	--- 싱크된 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 싱크된 대상 방향 (초기값 : vector3.right)
	dir_vector = vector_util.right,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,

	--- 이펙트 생성으로부터 지나간 시간
	fx_time_passed = nil,
	--- 강화 발동 여부
	enhance_applied = nil,
	--- 마지막 강화 공격 이후 지나간 시간
	enhance_time_passed = nil,
	--- 공격 루프 효과음
	sfx_holder = nil,

	--- 이전 타격 횟수
	num_hits = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이 (사용하지 않고 있음)
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- 일반 공격 배율
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	--- 강화 공격 배율
	self.enhance_atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'EnhanceModifier')
	--- num hits per sec
	self.hits_per_sec = 1 / self.action_duration

	--- 판정 시작 시점 (매크로 방지 용으로, 코드에서 action_duration 기반으로 설정한다)
	self.hit_timing = self.action_duration * 0.5
	--- 판정 크기 비율
	self.scale_factor = 1
	--- 판정 거리
	self.base_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseLength')
	--- 판정 폭
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 강화 확률
	self.enhance_probability = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'EnhanceProbability')
	--- 강화 인터벌
	self.enhance_interval = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'EnhanceInterval')

	--- visual only
	self.fx_offset = 0.35

	--- 대시 속도
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- ai에 적용될 대시 속도
	self.dash_speed_for_ai = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeedForAi')
	--- 대시 지속 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 연출 분기 처리
	self.is_ascent = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(param, 'IsAscent')
	--- 이펙트 프리셋 분기 처리
	local mei_origin_id = 53
	self.use_alternative_key = self.is_ascent and self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.OriginId == mei_origin_id

	self:apply_option(param)

	--- 판정 생성
	local owner_size = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner)
	local size = vector(self.base_length * self.scale_factor + math.max(owner_size.x, owner_size.z) * 0.5, owner_size.y, width * self.scale_factor)
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, nil, nil, true)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true
		--- 강화 공격 회복 비율
		self.heal_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'HealModifier')
		--- 판정 크기 비율
		self.scale_factor = self.scale_factor + cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ScaleFactorAdd')

		--- parsing each info
		battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, option_param)
	end

end

function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	local owner_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner)
	local target_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(target)
	local dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
	local dist_on_ray = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(owner_bounds, target_bounds, dir)

	local dash_dist = 0
	if dist_on_ray > 0 then
		local speed = dist_on_ray * 2 / self.dash_duration
		speed = math.min(self.dash_speed_for_ai, speed)

		dash_dist = speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5
	end

	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	return dist <= dash_dist + self.base_length
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(prev_state)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- action state가 아니었을때만 설정
	if prev_state ~= self then
		--- set locked dir
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
		--- start animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
		--- play loop sfx
		self.sfx_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')

		local fx_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.fx_offset
		local fx_rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(vector_util.right, self.dir_vector)
		self.punch_fx = self:refresh_effect(fx_pos, fx_rot)
		self.punch_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1 * self.scale_factor, 1, (self.dir_vector.x >= 0 and 1 or -1) * self.scale_factor)

		self.fx_time_passed = 0
		self.enhance_time_passed = 0
		self.enhance_applied = false
	end

	local final_speed = 0
	if self.target then
		final_speed = battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed_for_ai,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Slide,
			false,
			0.15
		)
	else
		final_speed = battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			nil,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed_for_ai
		)
	end

	if final_speed > 5 then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'dash', character_util.get_position(self.owner))
		character_util.jump(self.owner, 0.275, 0.3)
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(next_state)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	if next_state ~= self then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.punch_fx)
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
		sfx_util.fade_out(self.sfx_holder, 0.2)
		self.sfx_holder = nil

		if self.is_ascent then
			battle_util.cancel_camera_shake('china_hero_acsent')
		end
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 타이머 갱신
	self.fx_time_passed = self.fx_time_passed + dt
	self.enhance_time_passed = self.enhance_time_passed + dt

	--- 공격중이 아니라면 바로 취소해버린다.
	if not self.action.attacking then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(self.action.groggy_state)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))

		return
	end

	--- 타겟이 있는 경우 방향 갱신
	if self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 애니 재설정
	if self.enhance_applied and self.enhance_time_passed >= 0.2 then
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack_refresh')
		self.enhance_applied = false
	end

	--- 캐릭터 중심
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

	--- 이펙트 위치 및 로테이션
	local fx_pos = center + self.dir_vector * self.fx_offset
	local fx_rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(vector_util.right, self.dir_vector)

	--- 이펙트 재생성
	if self.fx_time_passed >= 0.6 then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.punch_fx)
		self.punch_fx = self:refresh_effect(fx_pos, fx_rot)
	--- 재생성하지 않았다면 위치, 방향을 갱신한다.
	else
		effect_util.update_object(self.punch_fx, fx_pos)
		self.punch_fx.transform.localRotation = fx_rot
	end

	--- 스케일 갱신 (flip 처리 용)
	self.punch_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1 * self.scale_factor, 1, (self.dir_vector.x >= 0 and 1 or -1) * self.scale_factor)

	if time_passed > self.hit_timing then
		local start_idx = math.floor((old_time_passed - self.hit_timing) / self.action_duration)
		local end_idx = math.floor((time_passed - self.hit_timing) / self.action_duration)

		if start_idx ~= end_idx then
			--- 강화 유효성 체크
			local normal_hit = self.enhance_time_passed < self.enhance_interval or unity_class.random.value > self.enhance_probability

			--- 일반 공격
			if normal_hit then
				self:check_collision(center, self.dir_vector)
			--- 강화 공격
			else
				--- 단순 info 생성
				local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
				--- 싱크 커맨드 생성
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 대시 중이면 대상을 갱신하지 않는다.
	if not battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner) or lua_helper.type_compare(self.owner.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.ShortDashState) then
		return
	end

	local next_target
	local next_dir
	--- 대상이 유효하지 않다면 다시 탐색한다.
	if not self.target or not battle_util.is_targetable(self.owner, self.target) then
		--- 원거리 타겟 탐색
		next_target, next_dir = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.search_range)
	--- 대상이 유효하지만, 공격할 수 없는 거리라면 대시를 시도 한다.
	elseif CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceBetween(bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner), bounds_util.get_bounds(self.target)) > self.base_length * 0.75 then
		next_target = self.target
		next_dir = self.dir_vector
	end

	--- 갱신이 필요한 경우 싱크한다.
	if next_target then
		--- 단순 방향 갱신
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, next_target)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, next_dir)
		--- 커맨드 생성
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

function action_state_class:refresh_effect(pos, rot)
	local fx_instance = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		self.use_alternative_key and 'attack_alt' or 'attack',
		pos,
		rot
	)

	self.fx_time_passed = 0
	if self.is_ascent then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.033, 0.6, 'china_hero_acsent')
	end

	return fx_instance
end

function action_state_class:check_collision(pos, dir_vector, is_enhance)
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
		self.cs_action,
		is_enhance and self.enhance_atk_modifier or self.atk_modifier,
		self.hits_per_sec
	)

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, pos)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, dir_vector)

	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	for _, t in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
		self:apply_damage(t, modifier, is_enhance)
	end

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, is_enhance)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	--- 이펙트 정보
	damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect.Create(bounds_util.get_center(target))

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	local result_info = command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 전무 효과 발동
	if is_enhance and self.activate_cwp_option and result_info then
		local total_damage = result_info:GetTotalDamage()
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = heal_type.drain
		heal_info.sender = self.owner
		heal_info.target = self.owner
		heal_info.heal = math.floor(total_damage * self.heal_modifier)

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
	end
end

--- 강화 공격 발동
function action_state_class:activate_enhance_attack()
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

	self.enhance_time_passed = 0
	self.enhance_applied = true

	if self.is_ascent then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.13, 0.14)
	elseif battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		stage_camera:DefaultShootingShake(vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector), 0.015, 0.14)
	end

	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'enhance')
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'enhance')
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		'enhance',
		center + self.dir_vector,
		unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(vector_util.right, self.dir_vector)
	)

	self:check_collision(center, self.dir_vector, true)
end

--endregion

--region groggy state

local groggy_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,

	--- 그로기 시간
	groggy_duration = nil,
}
groggy_state_class.mt = { __index = groggy_state_class }

--- create groggy state
function groggy_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function groggy_state_class:init(_)
	self.groggy_duration = 0
end

--- 스테이트 성격상 사용될것 같진 않지만 명시해둠
function groggy_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- field state enter
function groggy_state_class:enter(prev_state)
	if prev_state == self.action.action_state then
		local left_time = prev_state.current_time_passed % prev_state.action_duration
		self.groggy_duration = left_time > prev_state.hit_timing and prev_state.action_duration - left_time or 0
	end
end

function groggy_state_class:exit(next_state)
	self.groggy_duration = 0
end

--- field state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function groggy_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 액션 완료 루틴
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.groggy_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

--endregion


function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 스테이트 클래스
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	self.groggy_state = groggy_state_class:new(self, params)

	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.groggy_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.groggy_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.groggy_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.state_machine and not self.state_machine:is_nil_state() and self.state_machine.state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(self.groggy_state)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) then
			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end
	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 방향이 있으면 액션 시작 싱크
	if trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		self.action_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state, true)
	--- 없다면 강화 공격으로 취급한다.
	else
		self.action_state:activate_enhance_attack()
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 수도승 천려 (cyborg_monk) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualCyborgMonkBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 브레이크 계수
	break_modifier = nil,

	--- 발사 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper_table = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec_table = nil,

	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,

	--- 액션 타입
	action_type = nil,
	--- 왼,좌,양손 구분
	punch_type = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 브레이크 계수
	self.break_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StaminaBreakModifier')

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper_table, self.proj_spec_table = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 투사체의 최대 사거리
	local proj_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec_table[1])
	--- 투사체 최대 사거리로부터얻은 hittable_range
	self.hittable_dist = proj_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 발사 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = 0.5

	--- 왼손 오른주먹 스테미나 브레이크 구분을 위한 구분자
	self.action_type = {
		left = 1,
		right = 2,
		stamina_break = 3
	}

	--- 기본값 세팅
	self.punch_type = self.action_type.right
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return self.shoot_helper_table == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper_table)
end

--- 액션 중 움직일 수 있는지?
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- 대상과 공격 거리 비교
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 넘어온 인자가 1이라면 left, 2 = right (발사 방향이 아닌 해당 방향에서의 왼손, 오른손 여부)
	self.punch_type = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 스테미나 사용
	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)

	--- 공격 대상 바라보기
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 캐릭터 반동
	character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.05, 0, 0.2, 1)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 애니 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 정권지르기 애니메이션 타이밍에 맞춰 발사한다.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.1) then
		self:shoot_projectile()
	end

	--- 액션 시간이 만료 되었다면
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.action.attacking and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self.action:on_action_available()

		else--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
			--- state reset
			self.machine:change(nil)
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 타겟이 유효한 경우
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		--- modifier 계산
		local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
			self.cs_action, self.action_duration, self.break_modifier - 1
		)

		--- 힛 이펙트 생성
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec_table[label], bounds_util.get_center(hit_info.target))

		--- 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage(hit_info.target, modifier)

		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.12)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 주먹모양 투사체를 발사한다. (바라보는 방향 오른쪽 기준 주석)
--- 왼손, 오른손 위치를 보정하여 발사
function action_state_class:shoot_projectile()
	--- 발사될 위치에 대한 포지션, 사용자위치 + 목표방향에 대한 발사 위치 보정 추가
	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector
	--- 바라보는 방향의 "수직" 벡터. 아래방향 기준, 수평에 해당되는 벡터값 (오른쪽 바라보고 왼손은 위. 오른손은 아래)
	local offset_vector = vector_util.normalized(unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.dir_vector) * 0.21

	local is_left = self.punch_type == self.action_type.left

	--- 좌 우 평타 번갈아 가며 애니메이션 쓰기
	if is_left == true then
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'left')
	else
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'right')
	end

	--- 바라보는 방향이 반대인 경우 오프셋 째로 회전하면 반전에 반전됨으로 이것을 수동 보정
	--- 투사체 오브젝트에 이미 좌우 반전에 대한 보정(Flip)이 적용된 상태
	--- to_side_dir 사용 안한 이유는 flip과 동시 사용하면 수직(위아래)를 쳐다볼 경우 꼬이는 현상 있음.
	local need_flip = self.dir_vector.x <= 0

	if is_left == need_flip then
		shoot_pos = shoot_pos - offset_vector
	else
		shoot_pos = shoot_pos + offset_vector
	end

	--- 투사체의 발사 vfx,sfx 생성
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec_table[self.punch_type], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)
	projectile_spec_util.play_shoot_sfx(self.proj_spec_table[self.punch_type])

	--- shoot projectile
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper_table[self.punch_type], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, self.punch_type)

	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.12)
end
--endregion

--region break state
local break_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,

	--- 브레이크 공격 판정 타이밍
	break_hit_timing = nil,
	--- 브레이크 계수
	break_modifier = nil,

	--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 전용 무기 디버프 정보
	cwp_debuff_info = nil,

	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
break_state_class.mt = { __index = break_state_class }

--- create action state
function break_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function break_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 브레이크 계수
	self.break_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StaminaBreakModifier')

	--- 브레이크 공격 판정 타이밍
	self.break_hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'BreakHitTiming')

	--- 브레이크 공격 판정 길이
	local break_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 브레이크 공격 판정 너비
	local break_width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 브레이크 공격 판정 크기
	local size = vector(break_length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, break_width)
	--- 브레이크 공격 충돌체 정보
	local break_collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, nil, nil, true)
	--- 브레이크 공격 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, break_collision_info)

	self:apply_option(param)
end

function break_state_class:apply_option(param)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if activate_option then
		--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true
		--- 적중 대상에게 적용할 방깎 디버프 정보
		self.cwp_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'Debuff')
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
function break_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 액션 중 움직일 수 있는지?
function break_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

function break_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function break_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 스테미나 사용
	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)

	--- 공격 대상 바라보기
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 애니 요청
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'break')

	--- 캐릭터 반동
	character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.3, 0, 0.15, 1)
end

--- action state exit
function break_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 애니 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- end calculator
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
function break_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 어택 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end

	--- 어택 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.05) then
		--- 스테미나 브레이크 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'break', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector
		)
		--- play sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'break')
		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.25)
	end

	--- 판정 타이밍 순회
	for index = 1, #self.break_hit_timing do
		--- 판정 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.break_hit_timing[index]) then
			--- modifier 계산
			local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
				self.cs_action, self.action_duration, self.break_modifier - 1
			)

			--- 스테미나 브레이크 계산
			modifier = modifier * self.break_modifier / #self.break_hit_timing

			--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
			--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 설정
			area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
			--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- 범위내 대상들에게 피해를 적용한다.
			for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end

			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

function break_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 전무 옵션 발동
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.cwp_debuff_info)
	end
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 일반 공격 클래스
	self.normal_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 브레이크 어택 클래스
	self.break_state = break_state_class:new(self, params)

	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.normal_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.break_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.normal_state, self.break_state)

		self.normal_state = nil
		self.break_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부 & 스테이트 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.normal_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.state_machine and not self.state_machine:is_nil_state() and self.state_machine.state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.normal_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and
			battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 타겟 탐색 (투사체용 타겟 서칭)
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 브레이크 공격 타이밍이라면 스테미나 브레이크
	if discrete_stamina_action_util.is_break_attack(self.cs_action) then
		trigger_info_util.append_number(info, self.normal_state.action_type.stamina_break)
	else
		--- 일반 평타라면 왼손, 오른손 결정을 결정하고 state로 Sync해준다
		if self.normal_state.punch_type == self.normal_state.action_type.right then
			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, self.normal_state.action_type.left)
		else
			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, self.normal_state.action_type.right)
		end
	end

	--- 커맨드 전파
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info) ~= self.normal_state.action_type.stamina_break then
		self.normal_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.normal_state)
	else
		self.break_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.break_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param move_info any Projectile.MoveInfo 프로젝타일의 움직임 정보
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @param label number 프로젝타일의 식별하기 위한 일종의 ID
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.normal_state == nil then return true end

	--- 일반 평타에만 투사체가 있음으로 이대로 한다.
	return self.normal_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
