--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 용사 다이 (dai) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualDaiBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 공격 타입
	attack_type = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 최대 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 정의된 액션 타입
	action_type = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 콤보 액션 연계를 위한 시간
	finished_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 공격 타입
	self.attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 정의된 액션 타입
	self.action_type = {
		--- 내려 찍기
		stomp = 'stomp',
		--- 베기
		slash = 'slash',
		--- 검기
		strike = 'strike'
	}

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
	--- 대시 거리
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.stomp then
		self.attack_timing = self.dash_timing + self.dash_duration
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		self.attack_timing = self.action_duration * 0.16
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.strike then
		self.attack_timing = self.dash_timing + self.dash_duration
	end

	--- 대시 거리
	dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5
	--- 대시 종료 타이밍
	self.dash_end_timing = self.dash_timing + self.dash_duration

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.stomp then
		--- 최대 판정 횟수
		self.max_hit = 1

		--- 판정 반지름
		local radius = 1.75
		--- 판정 오프셋
		self.offset = 1.5

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info)

		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist + self.offset + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

		--- 넉백 강도
		self.knock_back_force = 12000

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		--- 최대 판정 횟수
		self.max_hit = 1

		--- 판정 반지름
		local radius = 1.5
		--- 판정 각
		local angle = 180

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(
			radius, angle, height, self.action_duration * 0.9 - self.attack_timing
		)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

		--- 넉백 강도
		self.knock_back_force = 16000

		--- 무기 옵션 적용
		self:apply_option(param)

	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.strike then
		--- 최대 판정 횟수
		self.max_hit = 3

		--- 판정 길이
		local length = 5
		--- 판정 너비
		local width = 1.5

		--- 충돌체 크기 벡터
		local size = vector(length, height, width)

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, self.action_duration, 0.12, true)
		--- 충돌체 계산기
		self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, true, self.hit_timing, self.max_hit)

		--- hittable distance
		self.hittable_dist = dash_dist + length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

		--- 넉백 강도
		self.knock_back_force = 2000
	end
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 전용 무기 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 전용 무기 데미지 타입
		self.cwp_damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BaseDamageType')

		--- 슈터 설정
		self.cwp_cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
		--- 헬퍼, 스펙 설정
		self.cwp_shoot_helper, self.cwp_proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(
			self.cwp_cs_shooter, option_param
		)

		--- 전용 무기 옵션 피해량 계수
		self.cwp_atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'AttackModifier')

		--- 전용 무기 디버프 정보
		self.cwp_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	--- 전용 무기 옵션이 활성화 되었을때
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		--- 헬퍼가 로드됐는지 체크
		return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.cwp_shoot_helper)
	end

	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 고정 요청
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 바라보는 방향
	local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
	--- 좌우 인지
	local is_side = (look_dir & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None
	--- 애니메이션 키
	local anim_key = (self.attack_type ~= self.action_type.slash or is_side) and 'action' or 'action2'

	--- 액션 애니메이션 요청
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, anim_key)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료 (종료가 안됐을 수 있기에)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 애니메이션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- [GT-1003] 숏 대시 동안에는 위치 보간이 이루어지지 않는다.
		--- 대시 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)
	end

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.stomp then
		self:stomp_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed)

	else
		self:action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function action_state_class:stomp_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	--- 판정 시작 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 내려찍기 위치
		local stomp_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector

		--- 내려찍기 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'stomp', stomp_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--- 내려찍기 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'stomp')

		--- 모디파이어 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, stomp_pos)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- ifo 순회
		for _, t in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, _)) do
			--- 데미지 적용
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.17, 0.12)
	end
end

function action_state_class:action_routine(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 판정 시작 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 베기인지
		local is_slash = self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash

		--- 판정 위치
		local attack_pos = is_slash and bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) or character_util.get_position(self.owner)
		--- 판정 방향 벡터
		local attack_dir_vector = is_slash and vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector) or self.dir_vector
		--- follow 컨테이너
		local container = is_slash and spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner) or nil

		--- 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, self.attack_type, attack_pos + 0.3 * attack_dir_vector, attack_dir_vector, container
		)
		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, self.attack_type)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, attack_dir_vector)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 흔들기 강도
		local shake_magnitude = is_slash and 0.12 or 0.2
		--- 흔들기 시간
		local shake_duration = is_slash and 0.1 or 0.15

		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, shake_magnitude, shake_duration)

		--- 무기 옵션이 발동했을때
		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			--- 투사체 발사 사운드 재생
			projectile_spec_util.play_shoot_sfx(self.cwp_proj_spec[1])
			--- 투사체 발사
			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
				self.cwp_shoot_helper[1], attack_pos + 2 * attack_dir_vector, self.dir_vector
			)
		end
	end

	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 모디파이어 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- ifo 순회
		for _, t in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)) do
			--- 데미지 적용
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
		end

		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = self.dir_vector
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.knock_back_force = self.knock_back_force

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.cwp_shoot_helper == nil or self.cwp_proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 타겟
	local t = hit_info.target

	--- 공격 가능한 경우
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) then
		--- 데미지 정보 생성

		damage_info.damage_type = self.cwp_damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive
		damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action) | damage_source_type.cwp_option
		damage_info.sender = self.owner
		damage_info.target = t
		damage_info.modifier = character_util.get_atk_2_dps(self.owner) * self.cwp_atk_modifier

		--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	if target then

	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))

--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	if not battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		dash_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
	end

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner),
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		dash_dist * dir_vector
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	if closest_object == nil then
		closest_object = target
	end

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(
		bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner), bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), dir_vector), dash_dist
	)

	return battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, target) <= min_dist + self.radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

		--- 대상
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 대상 방향
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	if not battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		dash_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale
	end

	--- 타겟이 있는 경우
	---FIXME: 빠른 돌진이 아니라면 여기 코드 개선 필요
	if target then
		--- extension cache
		local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
		local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

		--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
		local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
			bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner),
			entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
			dash_dist * dir_vector
		)

		--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
		if closest_object == nil then
			closest_object = target
		end

		--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
		local distance = bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(
			bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner), bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), dir_vector
		)

		--- 목표 위치
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.owner.Position + math.min(distance, dash_dist) * dir_vector)
	else
		--- 목표 위치
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.owner.Position + dash_dist * dir_vector)
	end

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 목표 위치 Sync
	self.sync_position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	--- 방향 Sync
	self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self:change_state(self.state.action)
end


function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 스테이트가 돌아갈 필요가 없을때
	if self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.current_time_passed
	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state.update then
		self.current_state.update(self, old_time_passed, self.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.finished_time_passed = self.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.action_duration <= self.current_time_passed then
		self:state_end_routine()
	end
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine()
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if self.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self:change_state(self.state.none)

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region action state
function local_class:enter_action_state(_)
	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	local magnitude = (self.sync_position - self.owner.Position).magnitude
	local speed = magnitude / self.dash_duration / 0.5

	battle_util.melee_short_dash(self.cs_action, nil, self.sync_dir_vector,
		0, self.dash_duration, speed, speed, nil, false, 0
	)

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.sync_dir_vector))
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
end

function local_class:exit_action_state(_)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- instantiate slash fx
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'slash',
			self.owner.Position + 0.7 * unity_class.vector3.up + 0.2 * vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.sync_dir_vector),
			vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.sync_dir_vector), spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- play slash sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'slash')
	end

	--- 충똘체 위치 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
	local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			self:apply_damage(target)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end
--endregion

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)
	damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	local result_info = command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 힐관련 계수가 존재 한다면
	if self.activate_special_option and self.heal_modifier > 0 then
		--- DamageCommand일 경우에만 적용
		--- 크레이그의 '전우 보호'가 발동할 경우 힐하지 않음 (DamageReplaceCommand)
		if result_info then
			self:apply_heal(result_info:GetTotalDamage())
		end
	end
end

--- 흡혈 적용
--- @param damage number 가한 데미지
function local_class:apply_heal(damage)
	if damage > 0 then
		local master = summonable_util.get_master(self.owner)

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = heal_type.drain
		heal_info.sender = self.owner
		heal_info.target = master
		heal_info.heal = math.floor(damage * self.heal_modifier)

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
	end
end

--region option routine

function local_class:apply_option(_, params)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	local master = summonable_util.get_master(self.owner)

	--- 마스터가 옵션을 가지고 있는지 판단
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, master)

	if activate_option then
		--- 데미지 비례 회복량 계수
		self.heal_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'HealModifier')

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 마왕 리리스(demon_ceo) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualDemonCeoBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	local parent = self.local_class

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then return end

	if parent.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if parent.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- state name
	name = nil,
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 콤보 인덱스
	combo_index = nil,
	--- 발사 시점
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 움직일 수 있는 타이밍
	can_move_timing = nil,
	--- 공격 적중할 거리
	attack_range = nil,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	finished_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

function action_state_class:new(parent_class, combo_index, shoot_timing, can_move_timing, attack_range)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj.combo_index = combo_index
	obj.shoot_timing = shoot_timing
	obj.can_move_timing = can_move_timing
	obj.attack_range = attack_range
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:set_param(target, dir_vector)
	self.target = target
	self.dir_vector = dir_vector
end

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing and self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing - 0.03) then
		--- 캐릭터 반동주는 연출
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, -self.dir_vector, 0.2, 0.35, 0.06)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		if self.action.shoot_helper then
			self:instantiate_slash()

			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
				self.action.shoot_helper[1], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector
			)
		else
			--- 시전 이펙트 생성
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', self.owner.Position, nil, self.owner.Transform)

			--- 클로 sfx 재생
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

			if self.target then
				local dist = battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, self.target)

				if dist > self.attack_range then
					self.target = nil
				end
			end

			self.action:publish_sync_action(
				self.target, battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.owner.Position + self.dir_vector * self.attack_range)
			)
		end

		--- 컨트롤 멈춤
		self.action.controlling = true
	end

	if self.combo_index == 2 and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing + 0.1) then
		self:instantiate_slash(1)
	end

	--- 움직일 수 있는 타이밍 일때
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.can_move_timing) then
		--- 컨트롤 풀어줌
		self.action.controlling = false
	end
end

function action_state_class:instantiate_slash(flag)
	flag = lua_helper.get_or_default(flag, 0)

	local fx_offset = 0.4
	local fx_dir = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector)
	local fx_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) - fx_offset * fx_dir

	--- 베기 이펙트 생성
	local slash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'slash', fx_pos, fx_dir)

	--- 베기 sfx 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'slash')

	if slash_fx then
		local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

		if look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			if flag == 0 then
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
			else
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, -1)
			end
		elseif look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			if flag == 0 then
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, -1)
			else
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
			end
		elseif look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			if (self.combo_index + flag) % 2 == 0 then
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, -1)
			else
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
			end
		elseif look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			if (self.combo_index + flag) % 2 == 0 then
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
			else
				slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, -1)
			end
		end
	end
end

--endregion

--region collision_state

local collision_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	attack_modifier = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = {},
	--- 판정 위치
	position = nil,
	--- 판정 반지름
	radius = nil,
	--- 판정 높이
	height = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0
}
collision_state_class.mt = { __index = collision_state_class }

function collision_state_class:new(parent_class, attack_modifier, hit_timing, radius, height)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj.attack_modifier = attack_modifier
	obj.hit_timing = hit_timing
	obj.radius = radius
	obj.height = height
	return obj
end

function collision_state_class:set_param(position)
	self.position = position
end

function collision_state_class:enter(_)
	local finish_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'finish', self.position)

	if finish_fx then
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
			stage_camera:Shake(0.125, 0.15)
		end

		--- 클로 sfx 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'finish')
	end
end

function collision_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			--- 판정 중심 높이
			local half_height = self.height * 0.5
			local center_pos = self.position + half_height * unity_class.vector3.up

			--- 이펙트 오프셋
			local fx_offset = 0.325
			local fx_pos = center_pos + fx_offset * unity_class.vector3.up

			--- 대상 위치에 적당히 클로 이펙트 생성
			local claw_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'claw', fx_pos)

			--- 클로 이펙트 연출에 따른 적절한 스케일 세팅
			if claw_fx then
				if (self.cs_action.ComboIndex + index) % 2 == 0 then
					claw_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
				else
					claw_fx.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
				end

				--- 클로 sfx 재생
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'claw')
			end

			if self.action.is_force_canceled == false then
				--- modifier 계산
				local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
					self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier, #self.hit_timing
				)

				--- 범위 내의 ifo
				local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(center_pos, self.radius, self.height)

				for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
					--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
						--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
						self.action:apply_damage(target, modifier)
					end
				end

				--- PooledSortedList dispose
				ifo_list:Dispose()
			end

			--- 판정이 끝난 상황
			if index == #self.hit_timing then
				--- 스테이트 머신 초기화
				self.action.explosion_state_machine:change(nil)
			end
		end
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	local attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 대상틀 탐색할 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 판정 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 높이
	local height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Height')

	if height == 0 then
		height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	end

	--- 현재 공격 타입
	local attack_type = string.lower(cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackType'))

	--- 발사 타이밍
	local shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 움직일 수 있는 타이밍
	local can_move_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CanMoveTiming')

	--- 공격 적중할 거리
	local attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackRange')

	--- 현재 움직일 수 있는가?
	self.controlling = false

	if attack_type == 'shoot' then
		--- 프로젝타일 슈터
		self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.owner)
		--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
		self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)
	end

	--- 실제 공격 타이밍
	local hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- 콤보 인덱스
	local combo_index = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'ComboIndex')

	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, combo_index, shoot_timing, can_move_timing, attack_range)
	self.collision_state = collision_state_class:new(self, attack_modifier, hit_timing, radius, height)

	self.current_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	self.explosion_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 강제 캔슬 되었는가
	self.is_force_canceled = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.current_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.explosion_state_machine:change(nil)

		self.current_state_machine = nil
		self.explosion_state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.collision_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.collision_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec, self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.shoot_helper = nil
		self.proj_spec = nil
		self.cs_shooter = nil

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and
		(self.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper))
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.current_state_machine and self.current_state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.controlling
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	local dist = battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, target)
	local range = self.proj_spec and projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1]) or self.attack_range

	return dist <= range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	self.cs_action.ComboTarget:SetTarget(nil)

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 캔슬 여부 리셋
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	--- 컨트롤 풀어줌
	self.controlling = false

	local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self.action_state:set_param(target, dir_vector)
	self.current_state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.current_state_machine:change(nil)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local explosion_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)

	self.collision_state:set_param(explosion_pos)
	self.explosion_state_machine:change(self.collision_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state_machine then self.current_state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.explosion_state_machine then self.explosion_state_machine:update(dt) end
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.current_state_machine:change(nil)

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.current_state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 지속 시간 만료 이거나 피해를 줄 수 있는 오브젝트에 부딪혔을때
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction or
		hit_info.target and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then

		self:publish_sync_action(
			hit_info.target, move_info.position - bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up
		)

		--- 프로젝타일 만료
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:publish_sync_action(target, pos)
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, target.Position)
	else
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, pos)
	end

	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 유폐된 현자 비네트 (demon_engineer) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualDemonEngineerBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 브레이크 계수
	break_modifier = nil,

	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 발사 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper_table = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec_table = nil,

	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 브레이크 계수
	self.break_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StaminaBreakModifier')

	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 일반 투사체 projectile spec
	self.shoot_helper_table, self.proj_spec_table = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 투사체의 최대 사거리
	local proj_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec_table[1])
	--- 투사체 최대 사거리로부터얻은 hittable_range
	self.hittable_dist = proj_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 발사 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = 0.5
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return self.shoot_helper_table == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper_table)
end

--- 액션 중 움직일 수 있는지?
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- 대상과 공격 거리 비교
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 스테미나 사용
	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 애니메이션은 upper로 세팅. 캐스팅 중 이동하면 걸어야함
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	--- 애니 해제
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector
		)
	end

	--- IK 갱신
	spine_util.set_aim_point(
		self.owner, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	)

	--- 발사 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		self:shoot_projectile()
	end

	--- 액션 만료
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.action.attacking and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self.action:on_action_available()

		else--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
			--- state reset
			self.machine:change(nil)
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

--- [OnHit] 적중 시 피해, 특능으로는 자가회복
function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 타겟이 유효한 경우 데미지 계산
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		--- modifier 계산
		local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
			self.cs_action, self.action_duration, self.break_modifier - 1
		)

		--- 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage(hit_info.target, modifier)

		--- 피격 이펙트와 카메라 쉐이킹 약하게
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec_table[label], bounds_util.get_center(hit_info.target))
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.07)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 평타 적중에 대한 데미지 커맨드 처리
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	--- 기본 피격음은 제거. 투사체 hitsfx로 대체
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_mute_sfx_info()

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 투사체 발사 로직
function action_state_class:shoot_projectile()
	--- 시전자 위치 + 바라보는 방향 * 발사 오프셋 (총구쯤에서 쏘게끔)
	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

	--- 투사체의 발사 vfx, sfx 생성
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec_table[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)
	--- shoot projectile
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper_table[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector,1)
end
--endregion

	--- 브레이크 계수
	break_modifier = nil,

	--- 대상

	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,

break_state_class.mt = { __index = break_state_class }

--- create action state
function break_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)

	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

function break_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 브레이크 계수
	self.break_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StaminaBreakModifier')

	--- 브레이크 공격 판정 타이밍
	self.break_shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BreakShootTiming')

	self.self_heal_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SelfHealScale')

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper_table, self.proj_spec_table = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 투사체의 최대 사거리
	local proj_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec_table[2])
	--- 투사체 최대 사거리로부터얻은 hittable_range
	self.hittable_dist = proj_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 발사 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = 0.5
	--- 무기 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)
end

function break_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do
		repeat
			--- 옵션 유효성 확인
			local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

			--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
			if activate_option == false then
				break
			end

			--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
			local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

			if is_special then
			else
				self.activate_cwp_option = true

				self.cwp_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'Debuff')
			end

		until true
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
function break_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 액션 중 움직일 수 있는지?
function break_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- 대상과 공격 거리 비교
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

function break_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- break state enter
function break_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 스테미나 사용
	discrete_stamina_action_util.use_stamina(self.cs_action)

	--- 공격 대상 바라보기
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 애니메이션은 upper로 세팅. 캐스팅 중 이동하면 걸어야함
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'break')

end

--- break state exit
function break_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 애니 해제
    battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- break state update
function break_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector
		)
	end

	--- IK 갱신
	spine_util.set_aim_point(
		self.owner, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	)

	--- 투사체 발사 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.break_shoot_timing) then
		self:shoot_projectile()
	end

	--- 액션 시간이 만료 되었다면
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 다시 사용이 가능한 상태라면
		if self.action.attacking and battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- 액션을 사용
			self.action:on_action_available()

		else
			--- 사용이 불가능한 상태
			--- state reset
			self.machine:change(nil)
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

--- 투사체 발사
function break_state_class:shoot_projectile()
	--- 시전자 위치 + 바라보는 방향 * 발사 오프셋 (총구쯤에서 쏘게끔)
	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

	--- 투사체의 발사 vfx, sfx 생성
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec_table[2], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, nil, false)

	--- shoot projectile
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper_table[2], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, 2)
end

function break_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 타겟이 유효한 경우
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		--- modifier 계산
		local modifier = discrete_stamina_action_util.calculate_attack_modifier(
			self.cs_action, self.action_duration, self.break_modifier - 1
		)

		--- 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage(hit_info.target, modifier * self.break_modifier)

		self:apply_heal(self.owner, self.self_heal_scale)

		--- 투사체 적중 fx
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec_table[label], bounds_util.get_center(hit_info.target), hit_info.direction)

		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.12)

		return true
	--- 최대 사거리에 도달하여 자연 소멸한 경우 별도 이펙트 출력
	elseif hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'expire', hit_info.position, hit_info.direction)
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'expire')
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 브레이크 탄 적중에 대한 데미지 처리
function break_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	--- 기본 피격음 제거. 투사체 hitsfx로 대체
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_mute_sfx_info()

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 전무 옵션 발동
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.cwp_debuff_info)
	end
end

--- [특수능력] 회복 커맨드 처리
function break_state_class:apply_heal(target, modifier)
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(character_util.get_recovery(self.owner) * modifier)

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end
--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 일반 공격 클래스
	self.normal_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 브레이크 어택 클래스
	self.break_state = break_state_class:new(self, params)

	--- 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.normal_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.break_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.normal_state, self.break_state)

		self.normal_state = nil
		self.break_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부 & 스테이트 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.normal_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.state_machine and not self.state_machine:is_nil_state() and self.state_machine.state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.normal_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청
function local_class:persistent_begin(_)
	self.attacking = true
end

--- 배틀 액션 종료를 요청
function local_class:persistent_end()
	self.attacking = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end

	if self.attacking then
		if self:is_available() and
			battle_util.persistent_is_available(self.cs_action) and
			battle_util.is_there_stamina_for_action(self.cs_action) then
			--- start action
			self:on_action_available()
		end
	end
end

--- attacking 상태이고, Available 상태에 만족했을때의 처리
--- 일반적으로 배틀액션 State Sync
function local_class:on_action_available()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 타겟 탐색 (투사체용 타겟 서칭)
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 브레이크 공격 타이밍이라면 스테미나 브레이크
	if discrete_stamina_action_util.is_break_attack(self.cs_action) then
		trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 1)
	end

	--- 커맨드 전파
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_number(info) then
		self.break_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.break_state)
	else
		self.normal_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.normal_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param move_info any Projectile.MoveInfo 프로젝타일의 움직임 정보
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @param label number 프로젝타일의 식별하기 위한 일종의 ID
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if label == 1 then
		--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
		if self.normal_state == nil then return true end
		--- 평타 투사체 처리
		return self.normal_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	else
		--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
		if self.break_state == nil then return true end

		--- 브레이크 탄 처리
		return self.break_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)

	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 메뉴얼 배틀액션
--- 동부의 패자 모리안 (demon_governor) 일반 기술
local local_class = newclass('ManualDemonGovernorBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end

	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.finished_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
		self.state.finished_time_passed = self.state.finished_time_passed + dt
	end

	if self.state.action_duration <= self.state.current_time_passed then
		self.local_class:state_end_routine(self.state)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스

	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,

	--- 사출 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 사출 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,

	--- 폭발 처리용 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- 정의된 액션 유형
	action_type = nil,
	--- 이 액션의 공격 유형
	attack_type = nil,

	--- 움직일 수 있는 타이밍
	can_move_timing = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,

	cwp_buff_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간

}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action

end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	--- 대상 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 사출 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	--- 사출 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootOffset')

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 움직일 수 있는 타이밍
	self.can_move_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CanMoveTiming')

	--- 정의된 액션 유형
	self.action_type = {
		slash = 1,
		proj = 2
	}

	--- 이 액션의 공격 유형
	local attack_type = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackType')
	self.attack_type = self.action_type[attack_type]

	--- 폭발 반지름
	local radius = projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- 폭발 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(radius)
	--- 폭발 처리용 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 투사체 최대 거리
	local projectile_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = projectile_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	self:apply_option(param)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if activate_option then
		--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true
		--- 무기 옵션 버프
		self.cwp_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'ManualBuff')
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return self.can_move_timing > 0 and
		self.shoot_timing < self.current_time_passed and self.current_time_passed <= self.can_move_timing
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		--- set upper animation
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shoot')
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.proj then
		--- set upper animation
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

		self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + vector_util.up * 2, self.dir_vector
		)

		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove upper animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
	self.cast_fx = nil
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대상이 있는 경우 방향 갱신
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		self:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.proj then
		self:update_proj(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_slash(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- 사출 위치
		local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.shoot_offset
		--- 사출 이펙트 출력
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec[1], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector)
		--- 투사체 사출
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)

		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.1)
	end
end

function action_state_class:update_proj(old_time_passed, time_passed)
	--- 두사체 높이
	local height = 2
	--- 사출 위치
	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + vector_util.up * height

	if self.cast_fx then
		effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, shoot_pos)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- set animation
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
		self.cast_fx = nil

		--- 투사체 사거리
		local proj_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
		--- 목표 위치
		local target_pos = (self.target and proj_dist >= vector_util.distance(shoot_pos, character_util.get_position(self.target))) and
			character_util.get_position(self.target) or
			character_util.get_position(self.owner) + math.sqrt(proj_dist ^ 2 - height ^ 2) * self.dir_vector

		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, shoot_pos)
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, target_pos)

		--- 싱크 커맨드 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	local target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 1)

	--- 목표 위치를 향한 사출 방향
	local target_dir = vector_util.normalized(target_pos - shoot_pos)

	--- 사출 이펙트 출력
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos)
	--- 투사체 사출
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper[1],
		shoot_pos,
		target_dir,
		nil,
		nil,
		nil,
		false,
		nil,
		target_pos
	)

	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.12)
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- slash인 경우 대상 충돌시에도 소멸함
	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		--- 폭발 요청
		self:on_explosion(hit_info.position)
		--- 만료 시킨다.
		return true
	end

	--- 자연 소멸인 경우만 처리
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		--- 폭발 요청
		self:on_explosion(hit_info.position)
		--- 만료 시킨다.
		return true
	end

	--- 만료 하지 않는다.
	return false
end

--- 폭발 처리
function action_state_class:on_explosion(explosion_position)
	--- 이펙트 생성
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec[1], explosion_position)

	if self.attack_type == self.action_type.slash then
		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.12)
	elseif self.attack_type == self.action_type.proj then
		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.16, 0.15)
	end

	--- 폭발 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, explosion_position)
	--- 폭발 판정 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	--- 판정 처리
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)
	--- 폭발 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 판정된 대상이 없다면 생략한다.
	if #fo_list == 0 then
		return
	end

	--- 데미지 계수
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		--- 데미지 처리
		self:apply_damage(fo, modifier)
	end

	--- 옵션 발동 처리
	self:trigger_option()
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- 피격 효과음 정보 할당
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function action_state_class:trigger_option()
	if not self.activate_cwp_option then return end

	--- 자기 자신에게 버프 부여
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.cwp_buff_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 존재할때
	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 액션 상태가 유효할때만 처리
	if not self.action_state then return end

	self.action_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- action state가 유효할 때만 처리
	if not self.action_state then return true end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--region manual state end routine

function local_class:state_end_routine(state)
	local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
	local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

	if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
		return
	end

	if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
		if state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self.state_machine:change(nil)
		else
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	else
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
